faqs.question: What does a Higher Level Biology tutor cost per hour in Abu Dhabi?
faqs.answer: Market rates for IB specialist tutoring in the UAE run roughly AED 200 to AED 450 an hour, and Higher Level Biology sits in the upper half of that band. Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 table puts IB, IGCSE and A-Level specialists at AED 200 to AED 450 and above, TutorChase publishes AED 270, and Unitors lists IB tuition from AED 200. Entry tiers advertised from AED 33 to AED 65 are university-student and group formats rather than Higher Level science specialists. Ask any provider which of those models their quoted rate belongs to before comparing it with another.

faqs.question: Why is Higher Level Biology priced above Standard Level if the rate is the same?
faqs.answer: The hourly rate is usually identical. The total is not, because Higher Level is examined over two papers and carries an additional depth layer woven through every theme rather than added as a separate unit. That means more sessions across the two years, not a higher price per session. A Higher Level plan also cannot be assembled by teaching the Standard Level course and bolting depth on at the end, which is why the sequencing has to start in DP1. Families who buy Higher Level support late pay for the same content twice.

faqs.question: How many marks is the Biology scientific investigation, and how are they split?
faqs.answer: It carries 20% of the subject grade and 24 marks, divided evenly across four criteria at six marks each: research design, data analysis, conclusion and evaluation. Research design is the one that decides the other three, because a question that cannot be controlled produces data that cannot be analysed. Evaluation is usually the cheapest band to move, since most mid-band drafts list generic limitations rather than the specific weaknesses their own method produced. Confirm the current criteria and marks against the subject guide your child's Diploma coordinator holds for their examination session.

faqs.question: Can a tutor help with the Biology investigation without breaking the IB's honesty rules?
faqs.answer: Yes, within a clear boundary. A tutor can teach research design, teach the statistics the data needs, explain exactly what each of the four criteria rewards, and give feedback on a draft the student has already produced. What a tutor cannot do is supply text, supply data, or edit a draft into a submission. The report must be the student's own work and the school supervisor records that authenticity as part of the assessment. Some providers in this market sell completed reports outright; that is malpractice under IB rules and an expulsion risk for the student.

faqs.question: Does ADEK allow my child's own Biology teacher to tutor them privately for a fee?
faqs.answer: Press reporting on ADEK's professional-ethics rules for private and charter school staff indicates teachers are prohibited from providing paid private tutoring to students enrolled at their own school, and the MoHRE private tuition work permit carries a code of conduct that bars the same thing. Verify the current wording against ADEK's own policy document before relying on it. The practical effect is that the cheapest option many Abu Dhabi parents consider first is closed, and the lawful local pool is smaller than the number of Biology teachers in the emirate suggests.

faqs.question: Does a private Biology tutor in Abu Dhabi need a permit, and does it cost anything?
faqs.answer: Yes. Private tutoring in the UAE is regulated by the MoHRE private tutor work permit, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023. It is granted free of charge for two years. Eligible applicants include registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. Anyone tutoring without it is subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws, though no fine schedule is published, so treat any specific figure you are quoted with suspicion. MoHRE's own Private Tutor Licensing service lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time.

faqs.question: Do you send a Biology tutor to our villa in Khalifa City?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram does not offer home visits anywhere in the UAE; that is a service we run only in India. Every Abu Dhabi lesson runs one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time. The reason is worth stating rather than hiding: a Khalifa City family searching for someone who can drive over is limited to the Higher Level Biology tutors who live within a tolerable drive at 17:30 on a weekday. On screen the pool is every current-guide specialist available at that hour, which for a narrow subject is a materially different set of people.

faqs.question: Is an in-home Biology tutor actually more expensive than an online one in this emirate?
faqs.answer: Not reliably on rate. Bestimate puts in-home one-to-one at AED 180 to AED 350 and UAE home tutors generally at AED 200 to AED 500 once travel is included, against AED 200 to AED 450 for an online IB specialist. The ranges overlap. What differs is the pool you can reach and the scheduling: a tutor crossing the mainland in afternoon traffic cannot hold two consecutive evening slots, and a 30-minute diagnostic the night before a mock is not a journey anyone makes. Decide on reach and flexibility rather than on rate.

faqs.question: My son is scoring 5s in Higher Level Biology. How many hours does a 6 take?
faqs.answer: Nobody can honestly answer that before seeing marked work, and any provider who quotes a figure on the phone is guessing. What a diagnostic can establish quickly is which of four failures is costing the marks: recall gaps, command-term misreading, data-handling weakness in the Paper 1 data section, or running out of time. Each needs a different number of hours. Command-term repair is often the fastest, sometimes four to six sessions. Genuine content gaps across several themes take a term. Send one marked Paper 2 question and the trial lesson will produce a specific estimate.

faqs.question: We are starting in the February of DP2. Is that too late for Higher Level Biology?
faqs.answer: It is not too late to move a grade, but it changes what you can buy and what it costs. At that point the investigation is submitted and the research-design marks are fixed, so the work is entirely on the two written papers. Expect two sessions a week rather than one, built around marked papers rather than content teaching, and expect evening and weekend slots to be scarce because every Diploma family in the emirate is looking at the same time. The same total hours bought eighteen months earlier would have gone further.

faqs.question: Which part of Paper 1 costs Abu Dhabi students the most marks?
faqs.answer: The data-based section, consistently. Students who have revised well arrive able to recall processes and then meet an unfamiliar data set with error bars, awkward units and a trend they are asked to quantify rather than describe. Strong recall stops helping there. The repair is unseen data: a long run of data sets the student has never met, with the question stems removed so they have to decide what the data can support. That drill transfers directly to the extended-response marks in Paper 2 as well.

faqs.question: Can one tutor take Higher Level Biology and Higher Level Chemistry for the same student?
faqs.answer: Often, and it usually saves money. The two courses share enzyme kinetics, buffers, bonding and a good deal of the quantitative handling, so a single tutor explains the shared ground once rather than twice. Abu Dhabi families who book the two separately frequently pay for the same explanation in both slots. The caveat is depth: ask directly which of the two the tutor has taught at Higher Level most recently, and whether they have supervised investigations in both. A generalist across both sciences is not the same as a specialist in either.

faqs.question: Does Higher Level Biology help with UAE Ministry of Education equivalency?
faqs.answer: Equivalency rules are set by curriculum track rather than by individual subject strength. The published British-track requirement is five accredited IGCSE or GCSE subjects at no less than grade E or 3, with Arabic and Islamic education excluded from that count, plus one Advanced Level at E or two Advanced Subsidiary Levels at the same grade. No IB points threshold could be read on an official ministry source, so no figure is published here; one competitor's claim that six IGCSE subjects are required is incorrect. Verify your child's position on the ministry's own channel.

faqs.question: What happens to our weekly Biology session during Ramadan in Abu Dhabi?
faqs.answer: It moves. School hours shorten, and a 17:30 slot that worked in January is usually the wrong time in Ramadan. Most families shift to a post-Iftar slot, commonly between 21:00 and 22:30 Gulf Standard Time, and some drop to a shorter session twice a week rather than one long one. Because delivery is online there is no travel to rearrange around the changed hours. Tell us at the start of the month and the slot is rebooked for the whole period rather than renegotiated week by week.

faqs.question: What should the first Higher Level Biology session actually produce?
faqs.answer: A written list, not a feeling. By the end of the free trial you should have the specific gaps the tutor found, named by theme and by error type, an honest view of whether the problem is content or command terms, and an estimate of hours with a reason attached. If the investigation is live, you should also have a judgement on whether the research question can be controlled as written. A session that ends with general encouragement and no list has told you nothing you can act on.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-biology-hl-tutor.closingHeading: Start with one marked paper and a free trial
abu-dhabi/ib-dp-biology-hl-tutor.closingBody: Higher Level Biology is a two-paper subject with a 24-mark investigation attached, and the cost of supporting it in Abu Dhabi depends far more on when you start and what you buy than on the hourly rate. Market rates for IB specialists run AED 200 to AED 450, the sources are named on this page, and the honest saving available to most families is buying fewer hours earlier rather than more hours in the final term. Send one marked Paper 2 question and the school's investigation deadline, take the free trial online, and decide after it.

intro.heading: Why a biology quote in Abu Dhabi can be AED 60 or AED 600
paragraphs: Three of the six most visible tutoring pages for this market publish no price at all, and two of the three that do quote in US dollars, which is not the currency Abu Dhabi families transact in. The result is that a parent asking what Standard Level Biology support costs gets a range spanning an order of magnitude and no way to compare the ends of it. This page publishes the bands, names the source and the year of each, and explains what differs between a budget hour and a specialist one.

The honest summary is that four things move the number: who is teaching, whether anyone travels, whether marking and written records are inside the hour, and when in the two years you buy. A university student teaching online from outside the UAE sits at one end. A subject specialist marking written work and keeping records sits in the middle. A named examiner sits at the top. The published bands are set out in the first section, and none of them is our fee: tuition here is quoted on enquiry, after a free trial session.

Standard Level Biology is a 150-hour course examined through two written papers and one internal scientific investigation worth 20 per cent. That structure matters to the cost because the components respond differently to paid time. Investigation support is a defined block with a deadline, which makes it predictable to budget. Written technique work is weekly and slow. Content coverage is the most expensive thing to buy and the thing a school is already providing, which is why it is often the worst first purchase.

The second thing that moves a quote in this emirate is geography, and it is specific to Abu Dhabi rather than generic. An in-home tutor reaching Al Shamkha, Al Falah, Baniyas or Al Samha from the island in late-afternoon traffic can lose ninety minutes of working time to one lesson, and that time appears in the rate whether it is itemised or not. Families in those communities are quoted differently from families in Al Karamah or Al Wahda, for reasons that have nothing to do with biology.

Everything here is written for comparison rather than persuasion. The tables price the work by task so that two quotes can be put next to each other, the questions that change an invoice are listed before you have to ask them, and one section sets out what a family can do for nothing before paying anybody. Teaching is delivered one-to-one over live video in Gulf Standard Time slots, so no travel component is being charged for and no part of the emirate is quoted a different rate. Our own rate is given on enquiry after the trial session rather than printed here, which is a deliberate choice: a headline figure without knowing which component is weak would be a guess dressed as a price.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: Six subjects with three at Standard Level, plus Theory of Knowledge, the Extended Essay and Creativity, Activity, Service. Standard Level Biology satisfies the sciences requirement and is examined through two written papers and one scientific investigation carrying 20 per cent. The course runs across four themes examined at several levels of organisation, so the content is broad rather than deep.
programmes.countryNote: In Abu Dhabi the Standard Level biology group is usually the bigger of the two in a school and absorbs a wide range of ability. Families who budget for two years of weekly sessions from the start generally overspend; those who buy a defined investigation block and a short technique block in DP2 tend to get more grade movement per dirham.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: Assessed against four science criteria weighted towards investigation design, data processing and evaluation. Students arriving from MYP are generally well prepared for the Diploma investigation and less prepared for recall volume and written structure under time. The cost consequence is useful: the component that is most expensive to support later is the one MYP already prepared them for.
programmes.countryNote: Abu Dhabi has several IB continuum schools where this transition happens internally and is rarely flagged to parents. Families from this route who buy investigation support in DP1 frequently find they did not need it, while the written-technique block they skipped in DP2 is the one that would have moved the grade.

programmes.name: Cambridge and Edexcel upper secondary
programmes.description: Cambridge IGCSE Biology 0610 and Edexcel 4BI1 build strong factual foundations through short, directive questions. What they do not build is experience of unfamiliar data sets or extended written reasoning, both of which the Diploma papers test. Students from this route need fewer content hours and more technique hours than their parents usually expect.
programmes.countryNote: The British-curriculum sector in Abu Dhabi is large, so most Standard Level biology groups contain a majority of ex-IGCSE students. For a family budgeting carefully, the cheapest useful purchase in DP1 is a short block on data-based questions, because that skill is absent from the IGCSE experience and carries marks in both papers and in the investigation.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-biology-sl-home-tutor.subjectsIntro: Families rarely buy support for one subject alone, so the notes below include what each subject costs in effort relative to biology.

subjects.name: Biology
subjects.description: Four themes, two written papers and one investigation worth 20 per cent. The budget-efficient purchases are the investigation block and data-based question practice; broad content revision is the most expensive and most duplicative thing to buy, since the school is already teaching it.

subjects.name: Biology
subjects.description: Additional depth inside the same four themes, more taught hours and a longer written paper. Specialist rates for the Higher Level material sit at the upper end of published bands, and the investigation requires the same statistical work at both levels, so that block costs much the same either way.

subjects.name: Chemistry
subjects.description: Frequently taken alongside biology by health-science applicants. It fails quantitatively rather than structurally, so a family supporting both subjects should expect two different kinds of session and should not assume one science tutor covers both well.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
subjects.description: Its statistics content covers most of what the biology investigation needs, which removes an entire category of paid hours. Families whose child takes this route can usually skip a separate statistics block.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
subjects.description: Strong algebra and little applied statistics. Students on this route commonly need two or three paid sessions on spread, error bars and significance testing before they can process their own investigation data, and that cost should be planned for rather than discovered.

subjects.name: Environmental Systems and Societies
subjects.description: Shares the ecology material and can satisfy two requirements at once. Students who move here from biology mid-course need a short systems-thinking block rather than further biology, which is one of the cheaper transitions available in the Diploma.

subjects.name: Sports, Exercise and Health Science
subjects.description: Overlaps with human physiology in biology. Where both are taken, sequencing the revision deliberately means one set of paid hours serves two syllabuses, which is the clearest example of double duty in a Diploma package.

subjects.name: Psychology
subjects.description: Shares the biological approach to behaviour and makes similar written demands. Technique work bought for biology extended responses transfers here, so a family supporting both should buy the writing block once rather than twice.

subjects.name: Business Management
subjects.description: A common sixth subject. Its written-response style resembles biology extended answers more than students expect, so command-term work has value across both and is worth buying as a single block.

subjects.name: Theory of Knowledge
subjects.description: Falls in the same weeks as the biology investigation in most Abu Dhabi schools. Budgeting biology hours into those weeks without checking the core deadlines is the most common scheduling mistake families make.

sections.heading: What the Abu Dhabi market charges for Standard Level Biology
paragraphs: The table below collects the published figures rather than estimating them. Each band names the provider or survey that published it and the year, because a rate without a source is a negotiating position rather than information. Taken together they explain the spread a parent encounters: the bottom of the market and the top of it are not selling the same hour, and the middle is where most Diploma subject teaching actually sits.

Two patterns are worth noticing before reading the rows. First, the lowest advertised rates almost always describe online group or university-student teaching, not one-to-one Diploma subject specialists. Second, in-home rates carry travel inside them whether or not the quote says so, which is why the in-home band overlaps the specialist band despite describing less subject depth in many cases. Comparing a budget online rate with an in-home rate is comparing two different products.

None of these figures is our price. Tuition with IB Gram is quoted on enquiry after a free trial session, and the figures here exist so that you can judge any quote, ours included, against what the market publishes. If a provider will not tell you their rate until after a consultation, that is itself a data point: the two most visible agencies in this market publish no AED figure at all, and one of them asks the price question in its own FAQ and then declines to answer it. A provider who will not name a band before a consultation is reserving the right to price you rather than the work.

sections.heading: Where the Abu Dhabi travel premium actually comes from
paragraphs: Abu Dhabi is not a compact city and the Diploma schools are not evenly spread through it. A tutor based near the central school cluster who accepts a 17:30 lesson in Al Shamkha, Al Falah, Al Reef or Hydra Village is committing to a round trip that can approach ninety minutes in late-afternoon traffic. That time is unbillable and finite, which means it is recovered either in the hourly rate, in a minimum session length, or by the tutor declining journeys of that kind in the busiest weeks of the year.

This is why two families in the same emirate are quoted differently for identical teaching. It is also why in-home availability thins exactly when demand peaks: in the six weeks before mocks, tutors fill their diaries with the shortest journeys first. Families in peripheral communities regularly discover that the person who covered their child in DP1 is unavailable in the term that matters, and that the replacement wants a higher rate for the same distance.

IB Gram does not offer home visits in Abu Dhabi or anywhere else in the UAE; in-home visits are a service we run only in India. Teaching for Abu Dhabi families is delivered one-to-one over live video in Gulf Standard Time slots. The cost consequence is simple and worth stating plainly: there is no travel inside the rate, no minimum length imposed by a journey, and no difference between what a family in Madinat Zayed and a family in Al Karamah is quoted. What you give up is a person in the room; what you get back is distance made irrelevant to price and to availability.

sections.heading: Priced by task rather than by hour
paragraphs: An hourly rate is a poor unit for comparing quotes, because the work is not uniform. Teaching a research question until it is answerable is a different job from marking an extended response, and both are different from drilling unseen data items. The table below prices the recurring tasks in Standard Level Biology by the hours each typically absorbs, using the market bands from the previous section, so that two providers can be compared on the job rather than on the unit.

Three of these tasks carry most of the value in the course. The investigation block covers a component worth 20 per cent and has a fixed scope, which makes it the most predictable spend available. The data-based block transfers directly to both the paper and the investigation, so it does double duty. Written-technique work on extended answers is slow and addresses the largest component. Everything else is either content the school is already delivering or scheduling support that happens to look like teaching.

Use the table as a checklist when you take a quote. Ask which of these tasks the quoted hour includes, whether marking and written feedback sit inside it, and what happens to the price if the investigation deadline moves. Providers who price by package rather than by task should be asked to say which of these rows the package covers, because a monthly figure that looks competitive can quietly exclude the two rows that matter most.

sections.heading: What 150 taught hours contains, and which parts are worth paying twice for
paragraphs: Standard Level Biology is scheduled for 150 taught hours across two years, and your school is delivering all of them. Paying a tutor to repeat that delivery is the default purchase and the weakest one. The question worth asking is which parts of those 150 hours are structurally difficult to deliver to a class of twenty-five, because those are the parts where a second set of hours adds something rather than duplicating.

Three parts qualify. Individual feedback on extended writing is the first: a teacher with five classes cannot mark and discuss one long answer per student per week, however good they are. Statistical processing of one student's own investigation data is the second, since every data set is different and the help needed is specific. Unseen data-based practice is the third, because it requires immediate correction of a reasoning habit rather than exposition.

Content coverage does not qualify, with one exception: a genuine gap created by absence, a mid-year arrival in Abu Dhabi, or a topic missed during a change of teacher. Those gaps are real and worth paying to close, and they are narrow. A family that identifies two such gaps and buys four hours has spent well. A family that buys twenty hours of general revision has mostly paid for a second delivery of content that was already delivered, and the grade usually reflects that. The test for any content hour is whether the student could have got the same thing by attending a school clinic they are already entitled to.

sections.heading: Tutoring cost in context for an Abu Dhabi family
paragraphs: Tutoring is rarely the largest education line in an Abu Dhabi household budget, and seeing it next to the others changes how families decide. The table below places the published tutoring bands alongside the other costs that arrive in the same two years. The figures for tutoring are market bands from named sources; school fees vary so widely by school that only a band is meaningful, and your own invoice is the authority there.

One piece of context is often misapplied. KHDA announced in May 2026 that there would be no increase in school fees for private schools in Dubai for the 2026-27 academic year, under an economic incentives package. That applies to Dubai, not to Abu Dhabi, where fees are a matter for ADEK and the school. Families moving between the emirates should not assume the Dubai position applies to an Abu Dhabi invoice, and anyone quoting it at you as general UAE policy has not read it.

The useful reading of the table is proportional. Against two years of school fees, a defined investigation block plus a short technique block is a small addition that targets 20 per cent of one subject grade and the component carrying the largest share of marks. Two years of weekly sessions in a single subject, by contrast, approaches a meaningful fraction of a year's fees. That is not an argument against it; it is an argument for knowing which one you are buying before you commit.

sections.heading: The cheap hour that costs more
paragraphs: A low rate is not automatically poor value, and a high one is not automatically good. What matters is what the hour contains and what it leaves for you to do. At the bottom of the published bands the hour is usually teaching time alone: no marking, no written record, often a group rather than one-to-one, and frequently a tutor who studied the subject rather than one who teaches this syllabus. For a student who needs company while revising, that can be adequate and sensible.

It stops being adequate when the problem is technique. Extended written answers and data-based questions improve through marked attempts, and marking takes a tutor roughly as long as teaching does. An hour priced to exclude marking will exclude it, so the student writes less and the thing that was wrong stays wrong. Families often buy twelve cheap hours and achieve less than six hours would have achieved at a rate that included the marking, which is the most common false economy in this market.

There is also a time cost that never appears in a quote. Re-explaining a topic the student has already heard twice is comfortable for everybody and moves nothing. The expensive hour that identifies the actual error in the first twenty minutes has already outperformed four cheap hours of revision company. The way to tell the difference before paying is to ask what the first session will produce, and to treat a vague answer as the answer.

sections.heading: The questions that change the invoice
paragraphs: Ask these before the first paid session rather than after the third. Is the quoted rate per hour or per session, and how long is a session? Is marking of written work inside the rate? Are written notes or a progress record included, or billed? What is the cancellation window, and does a cancelled session carry forward or lapse? Does a package expire, and what happens to unused sessions at the end of term? Is there a different rate for the investigation block than for weekly teaching?

On tax, the only honest position is a narrow one. Ask any provider whether the price they quote you includes VAT, and get the answer in writing on the quote. This page does not state the UAE VAT treatment of tuition fees, because doing so would need a Federal Tax Authority citation rather than a confident paragraph, and several pages in this market assert a treatment without one. The practical protection is the same either way: a written quote that says whether the number is inclusive.

On anything described as free, check the condition on the same screen as the word. A free trial lesson here means a 45-minute working session with no card details required, which is the condition stated plainly rather than in a footnote. Where another provider offers a free assessment, ask what happens at the end of it and whether a package must be bought to receive the outcome. Those are reasonable questions and the answers are usually quick, which tells you something in itself.

sections.heading: Who you are actually paying, and the permit
paragraphs: Private tutoring in the UAE is regulated by permit. The MoHRE private tuition work permit was introduced under Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is granted free of charge for two years, and is open to teachers registered in government or private schools, employees in the government and private sectors, unemployed individuals, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. Individuals offering private tutoring without a permit from MoHRE are subject to fines and penalties outlined in the applicable laws, and no fine schedule is published, so no figure should be quoted at you.

MoHRE's own service page for the permit is listed as the issuance of a new work permit for private tutor licensing, applied for through the MoHRE smart app, website and e-services system, with no fee listed and a short stated completion time. That makes the question easy to ask and easy to answer. A tutor who holds one can say so; a provider who becomes vague when asked is telling you how they handle other inconvenient questions.

In Abu Dhabi there is an additional consideration. ADEK's professional-ethics expectations for private and charter school staff have been reported as prohibiting paid private tutoring of students enrolled at the teacher's own school, and the permit's code of conduct points the same way. Confirm the current wording with the school or on ADEK's own policy pages before acting on it. The practical implication for a family comparing prices is that the apparently convenient option, paying your child's own biology teacher, carries a risk that falls mainly on the teacher and is not a saving worth engineering.

sections.heading: What to do for nothing before paying anybody
paragraphs: Several of the things that move a Standard Level Biology grade cost no money at all, and a provider who does not mention them is not being straight with you. Start with the school. Ask the biology teacher for the assessment-objective breakdown behind the last grade, ask where the class sits against the scheme of work, and ask for the internal deadline calendar for the investigation. Many Abu Dhabi schools run subject clinics or revision sessions that students do not attend because nobody at home knew they existed.

Next, the official material. Past papers and syllabus documents belong to the IB, and they are available to students through their school rather than from a tutoring website; ask the coordinator what your child is entitled to access. Nobody should be selling you syllabus documents, mark schemes or grade-boundary tables, and a provider offering them as downloads is distributing material they do not own.

Then the free habits. Five cold retrieval questions a day, done properly, beat an hour of rereading notes and cost nothing. Writing one extended answer a week and comparing it with the published criteria is free if the student does the comparing. A study group of three that marks each other's long answers against the criteria is close to the most cost-effective arrangement available to a Diploma student. Buy paid hours for what these cannot do: an unfamiliar error nobody at home can diagnose, statistics the mathematics course never covered, and marking that needs someone who knows the criteria.

process.title: Say what you want to spend
process.description: A budget stated at the start produces better advice than one discovered at the end. A family with eight sessions to spend should be told which eight, and that answer differs from the plan for a family buying a term. Nobody needs to be talked up from a realistic figure to an aspirational one.

process.title: A free 45-minute trial, with no card required
process.description: The trial is a working session, not a consultation that withholds its findings. The student attempts items across the components and you are told which task rows from the table above are actually needed, with an estimate of hours for each. If the answer is fewer hours than you expected, that is the answer you receive.

process.title: Buy a scoped block, not an open arrangement
process.description: Investigation support is scoped to the school's deadlines. Technique blocks run four to six weeks and end. Weekly maintenance is available and is reviewed each term against the shorter alternative. Agreeing the shape before the first paid hour is what prevents a quiet annual commitment that nobody revisits.

process.title: Get the inclusions in writing
process.description: Before the first session, confirm in writing whether marking, written records and draft feedback are inside the rate, whether the quoted figure includes VAT, what the cancellation window is, and whether unused sessions carry forward. Every one of these has changed an invoice for somebody in this market.

process.title: Review the spend against the component
process.description: At the end of a block the question is whether the component that was weak has improved, not whether the sessions were pleasant. Where it has not, the right move is usually a different approach rather than more hours. Stopping is a legitimate outcome and should be on the table from the beginning.

whyPoints.title: Figures with sources attached
whyPoints.description: Every AED band on this page names the provider or survey that published it and the year. Three of the most visible pages in this market publish no price at all and two quote in dollars, so a sourced band in the local currency is the minimum a parent should expect before comparing quotes.

whyPoints.title: Priced by task, so quotes compare
whyPoints.description: The hour is not a standard unit, because marking and written feedback are inside it for some providers and extra for others. Pricing by task lets you put two offers side by side and see which rows each one actually covers.

whyPoints.title: No travel in the rate
whyPoints.description: Sessions run online in Gulf Standard Time, so the same teaching costs the same whether you are in Al Karamah or Madinat Zayed. In-home quotes in this emirate vary with distance because unbillable travel has to be recovered somewhere.

whyPoints.title: Blocks that end on a date
whyPoints.description: Investigation and technique support are scoped and finish. Nothing renews by default. A provider whose arrangement has no natural end point has an incentive worth noticing when the component you were worried about has already improved.

whyPoints.title: The free options named
whyPoints.description: School clinics, the assessment-objective breakdown, official material through the coordinator, cold retrieval and a study group that marks against the criteria all cost nothing. Paid hours are worth buying for what those cannot do, and a page that hides them is selling rather than advising.

whyPoints.title: No invented figures about ourselves
whyPoints.description: No success rate, no average grade improvement, no star rating appears here. Market bands describe the market. Our own tuition is quoted on enquiry after the trial, which is a smaller claim than a headline price and a more honest one.

faqs.question: What is a realistic monthly budget for Standard Level Biology support in Abu Dhabi?
faqs.answer: Bestimate's 2026 estimates for weekly one-hour sessions run AED 240-600 a month at the budget end, AED 600-1,200 in the middle tier and AED 1,000-2,000 or above for specialist exam-year support. Published packages in this market include AED 799 a month for eight online sessions and AED 1,599-1,799 a month for four in-home two-hour sessions. Those are other providers' figures, cited with their year. Which band you need depends on the component that is weak, and a scoped block often costs less overall than any monthly figure.

faqs.question: Why do quoted hourly rates in Abu Dhabi vary from AED 45 to AED 650?
faqs.answer: Because the ends of that range are not selling the same hour. At AED 45-65, as EdFlik publishes, you are usually buying online teaching time from a university-level tutor, frequently in a group, with no marking. At AED 650, as BartyED publishes, you are buying a named premium tutor. In the middle, Unitors publishes IB tuition from AED 200 and TutorChase AED 270 for specialists. Travel sits inside in-home rates whether itemised or not, which is why the in-home band overlaps the specialist band.

faqs.question: Is a package cheaper than paying for each session?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, and the saving is often smaller than the risk. Ask three questions before buying one: does it expire, do unused sessions carry forward, and what happens if the tutor turns out to be the wrong match in week two. A monthly package that looks competitive may exclude the two things worth paying for, marking and written feedback. Where a package genuinely covers those and the arrangement is already working, the discount is real. Where it is bought before the first session, you are pre-paying for an untested match.

faqs.question: What should be inside the hour, and what do providers charge extra for?
faqs.answer: At a minimum the hour should include teaching and the marking of work produced in it. Commonly charged separately elsewhere: marking written work set between sessions, written progress records, feedback on investigation drafts, and any report sent to parents. For biology specifically, marking is the item that matters most, because extended answers improve through marked attempts and marking takes a tutor roughly as long as teaching. An hour priced to exclude it will exclude it, and the student will write less as a result.

faqs.question: Does an in-home biology tutor in Abu Dhabi cost more than the same hour online?
faqs.answer: Generally yes, and the difference is travel. Published bands put in-home one-to-one at AED 180-350 in Bestimate's 2026 table, with reported rates to AED 500 for scarce subjects, against AED 150-300 for qualified online subject tutors. A round trip to Al Shamkha, Al Reef or Hydra Village in late-afternoon traffic can approach ninety minutes of unbillable time, which is recovered in the rate or in a minimum session length. IB Gram does not offer home visits in Abu Dhabi or anywhere in the UAE; in-home visits are a service we run only in India.

faqs.question: How many hours does the scientific investigation realistically need?
faqs.answer: For a Standard Level student, plan on one to two hours narrowing the research question, two to three on the statistics needed to process their own data, and three to four spread across dated drafts. At published market bands that is roughly AED 900-2,700 in total, for a component worth 20 per cent of the grade with a deadline you can see coming. It is the most predictable spend in the course. The research question stage is the part families skip and the part that caps the mark before any data exist.

faqs.question: Is a university student at a lower rate a false economy for Standard Level Biology?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily, and it depends on the job. For retrieval practice, keeping a student company through revision, or working through content they missed, a capable biology undergraduate at the lower published bands can be good value. For marking extended answers against published criteria, for investigation statistics, or for diagnosing why a hard-working student is stuck at 4, the criteria knowledge is the product and that is what the specialist bands are charging for. Buying the cheaper hour for the harder job is where most of the waste in this market happens.

faqs.question: Do prices quoted for tutoring in Abu Dhabi include VAT?
faqs.answer: Ask, and get the answer in writing on the quote. This page does not state the UAE VAT treatment of tuition fees, because that would require a Federal Tax Authority citation rather than a confident assertion, and several pages in this market assert a position without one. What you can rely on is a written quote that says whether the figure is inclusive. If a provider cannot answer that question clearly, treat it the way you would treat vagueness about any other part of the invoice.

faqs.question: Should we pay for group classes instead of one-to-one Standard Level biology?
faqs.answer: Group teaching is cheaper per student and suits content coverage, structured revision and keeping pace. It does not suit the two things that usually move a stalled biology grade, which are individual marking of extended answers and work on one student's own investigation data. A sensible hybrid exists: group or self-directed work for content, a small number of one-to-one hours for marking and the investigation. Paying one-to-one rates for content a group session could deliver is the opposite trade and the more expensive mistake.

faqs.question: When in the two years is biology support worth the most per dirham?
faqs.answer: Two windows. The first is whenever the investigation research question is being decided, because an unanswerable question caps the mark on 20 per cent of the grade and costs an hour or two to fix. The second is the four to six weeks before mocks in DP2, when written technique and data-based practice address the components carrying the most marks. The worst value is broad content revision bought early and open-endedly, which duplicates teaching the school is already delivering across 150 hours.

faqs.question: What can we do for nothing before paying anybody?
faqs.answer: Ask the school for the assessment-objective breakdown behind the last grade, for the class position against the scheme of work, and for the internal investigation deadlines. Find out whether the school runs biology clinics, because students frequently do not attend ones nobody at home knew about. Ask the coordinator what official material your child can access. Then set up five cold retrieval questions a day and one extended answer a week compared against the published criteria. A study group of three marking each other's answers is close to free and genuinely effective.

faqs.question: Does a tutor described as an examiner justify a higher rate?
faqs.answer: Only if the status can be evidenced, and even then it buys less than the marketing implies. Examiner experience does not provide access to unreleased papers, grade boundaries or marking decisions, and anyone suggesting otherwise is making a claim worth scrutinising. What examiner experience can genuinely bring is fluency with how criteria are applied, which is valuable for extended answers and investigation marking. Ask what the status is, when it applied and to which component, then judge the premium on the answer rather than on the label.

faqs.question: How does tutoring cost compare with what we already pay in school fees?
faqs.answer: Proportionally it is small for a scoped block and substantial for two years of weekly sessions. A defined investigation block plus a short technique block, at published market bands, is a modest addition that targets 20 per cent of one subject grade and the largest written component. Two years of weekly one-to-one in a single subject approaches a meaningful share of a year's fees. Note that the 2026-27 fee freeze KHDA announced applies to Dubai schools, not to Abu Dhabi, where fees are a matter for ADEK and the school.

faqs.question: If we stop biology sessions for a month during school examinations, what happens to the money?
faqs.answer: Confirm it in writing before the first session, because practice varies widely. Reasonable terms allow a stated notice period for cancellation, carry a cancelled session forward rather than lapsing it, and permit a pause for school examination weeks or travel without losing a package. During Ramadan most Abu Dhabi families move sessions to post-Iftar evenings or weekend mornings, and that should be a calendar change rather than a chargeable event. Ask specifically what happens to unused sessions at the end of a term.

faqs.question: Is Standard Level Biology cheaper to support than Higher Level?
faqs.answer: Modestly, and less than families expect. The hourly bands overlap heavily, because the scarcity premium attaches to the tutor's subject depth rather than to the level being taught. What genuinely differs is volume: Standard Level has fewer taught hours and less depth to cover, so content work is shorter. The investigation costs much the same at both levels, since it is marked against the same criteria and needs the same statistics. If a provider quotes a large discount purely for Standard Level, ask what is being left out.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-biology-sl-home-tutor.closingHeading: Get the task list before you get the quote
abu-dhabi/ib-dp-biology-sl-home-tutor.closingBody: The useful order is diagnosis, then task list, then price. Send the last paper your child sat and say what you are willing to spend. The free 45-minute session identifies which rows of the task table are actually needed, estimates the hours each would take, and tells you if the answer is fewer hours than you planned for. No card details are required to book it. If the conclusion is one investigation block and four weeks of marked writing rather than a two-year commitment, you will have the comparison in writing and can take it to any provider you like.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-biology-sl-tutor.tutorsIntro: The tutors listed below teach Standard Level Biology to Diploma students across Abu Dhabi. Each profile names the level taught, the papers covered and whether the tutor has supervised science investigations. Ask any of them for the format of the written record they keep; the answer tells you a good deal.

intro.heading: How you can tell whether Standard Level Biology tuition is working
paragraphs: Most families discover a tutoring plan has failed when the school report arrives, which in Abu Dhabi is usually twice a year. That is far too late to act on. Six months is two terms of a two-year Diploma, and in Standard Level Biology it is long enough for a student to slide from a 5 to a 4 while every weekly session felt perfectly productive. The problem is not the tutor's effort. The problem is that nobody wrote anything down that could be compared with anything else.

An evidence trail for Standard Level Biology is not complicated and it is not expensive, because it is built from work the student is already producing. Marked questions exist. Investigation drafts exist. Mock papers exist. What is usually missing is the sorting: a record that says this mark was lost to a recall gap in cell respiration, that one to misreading evaluate as describe, that one to running out of time on the last structured question. Sorted like that, four weeks of work tells you what six months of impressions cannot.

There are four ways a Biology mark goes missing and they need different fixes. Recall gaps are the slowest to repair and the easiest to spot. Command-term errors are the fastest to repair and the hardest to see, because the answer reads fluently and scores two out of five. Data-handling losses live almost entirely in the data-based half of Paper 1 and in the investigation's analysis criterion. Timing losses look like knowledge gaps on the final page of a paper and are nothing of the sort. A tutor who cannot tell you which of the four your child is losing to has not diagnosed anything.

The investigation produces the clearest evidence of all, because it arrives in drafts. A research question, a method, a first data set, a first full report. Each draft is a dated artefact that can be read against four published criteria worth six marks each. A tutor's job across that sequence is to teach the design, teach the statistics, explain exactly what each criterion rewards, and give feedback on what the student has written. The words stay the student's own. The drafts stay as evidence of whose work it is.

This page sets out what that record looks like in practice: what goes in the fortnightly note, how a marked paper is sorted, what the draft sequence should show, what grade movement is realistic over what period, and what to do when six weeks of evidence shows nothing has shifted. Lessons run online over live video. IB Gram does not send a tutor to a UAE address; home visits are a service we run only in India.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-biology-sl-tutor.programmesIntro: Standard Level Biology sits inside the Diploma Programme, and what counts as evidence of progress changes depending on which IB route a student reached it by. The three programmes below are the ones that matter for an Abu Dhabi Biology family.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: Six subjects across two years, three of them at Standard Level for most candidates, plus Theory of Knowledge, the Extended Essay and CAS. Standard Level Biology covers the same themes as Higher Level with less depth and a shorter Paper 2, and carries the identical scientific investigation at 20% of the subject grade. That identical weighting is why the investigation matters proportionally more to a Standard Level student: it is a fifth of the grade with no additional content layer to dilute it.
programmes.countryNote: Abu Dhabi Diploma cohorts are small, and a Standard Level Biology group of ten to fifteen is typical. Small groups mean a student sees very few examples of top-band answers written by peers, so the evidence trail has to supply what a larger cohort would supply socially. ADEK publishes inspection outcomes for the emirate's private schools, but an inspection band says nothing about one student's Paper 2 technique.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: Criterion-referenced assessment across five years. MYP Sciences marks inquiring and designing, and processing and evaluating, as separate criteria, which is the closest preparation available for the Diploma investigation. A student arriving from MYP usually produces a stronger first research question and a weaker recall base than a student arriving from an IGCSE stream.
programmes.countryNote: Several Abu Dhabi IB schools run MYP to the end of Year 11 rather than entering students for IGCSE. For an evidence trail that matters: an MYP-route student's early marked papers will show recall losses, and an IGCSE-route student's will show design and evaluation losses. Sorting the first month of marked work tells you which conversation to have.

programmes.name: Career-related Programme
programmes.description: A narrower IB route pairing a small number of DP courses with a career-related study and a reflective project. A CP student taking Standard Level Biology sits the same papers and submits the same investigation, but carries no Theory of Knowledge load, which changes what a realistic weekly hour looks like in the second year.
programmes.countryNote: The Career-related Programme is uncommon in Abu Dhabi, and a CP Biology student is frequently the only one in their year on that course. There is no cohort to compare marked work against, so a tutor's written record becomes the only comparator the family has.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-biology-sl-tutor.subjectsIntro: Standard Level Biology is the subject here, described below in terms of what evidence each part of it produces. The subjects after it are the ones Abu Dhabi students commonly carry alongside it, noted for what they contribute to, or take from, a Biology evidence trail.

subjects.name: Biology (Standard Level)
subjects.description: Two written papers plus the scientific investigation at 20%. Paper 1 splits into multiple choice and a data-based section. Paper 2 is structured and extended response. Because there is no additional depth layer to absorb attention, the evidence here is unusually clean: losses sort into recall, command term, data handling and timing with very little ambiguity.

subjects.name: Biology (Higher Level)
subjects.description: The same themes with an additional depth layer and a longer Paper 2. Students sometimes move down to Standard Level after DP1 mocks. The investigation work already done transfers intact, which means the draft sequence is preserved as evidence and only the content record needs rebuilding.

subjects.name: Chemistry
subjects.description: Shares enzyme kinetics, bonding and buffers with Biology. For an evidence trail, the useful point is that a student losing marks to the same quantitative weakness in both subjects has one problem, not two, and one tutor across both will spot that where two tutors separately will not.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
subjects.description: Holds the statistics a Biology investigation needs: standard deviation, chi-squared, correlation, error bars. A student's Mathematics marked work is useful evidence for a Biology tutor, because it shows whether the statistics problem is knowledge or transfer.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
subjects.description: Lighter on applied statistics, which produces a recognisable pattern in Biology evidence: fluent algebra, hesitant significance testing. A single statistics block taught against the student's own data usually closes it faster than general revision does.

subjects.name: Environmental Systems and Societies
subjects.description: Overlaps Biology's ecology strand. Where a student takes both, their marked work on ecosystems can be read across the two subjects, and a repeated loss in one usually appears in the other. That cross-reading is cheap evidence most families never use.

subjects.name: Psychology
subjects.description: Research methods are assessed explicitly, which transfers to the Biology investigation's evaluation criterion. A Psychology student's essays are a reasonable predictor of how well they will critique their own experimental method.

subjects.name: Sports, Exercise and Health Science
subjects.description: Shares human physiology with Biology. It is not an accepted substitute for Biology on most life-science applications, so a family considering the swap should check the specific faculty requirement with the school's university counsellor before the timetable closes.

subjects.name: Theory of Knowledge
subjects.description: Competes for the same weeks as the Biology investigation and the Extended Essay. An honest evidence review has to note the terms when a weekly science hour was not realistic, rather than reading a flat month as a failure of the plan.

subjects.name: Extended Essay
subjects.description: Separate from the investigation and supervised at school. Where the essay is in Biology, its drafts become part of the same evidence trail, and the authenticity record kept by the school supervisor applies to it in exactly the same way.

sections.heading: What goes in the fortnightly note, and why it is short
paragraphs: A useful progress record for Standard Level Biology fits on half a page. Long reports do not get read, and the ones that do get read tend to be narrative rather than comparable. What a parent needs is a small number of fields that look the same every fortnight, so that the fourth one can be held against the first.

Five fields carry almost all the information. What was taught, in syllabus language rather than in general terms. What marked work was reviewed, with the actual mark and the paper it came from. Which error type each lost mark was assigned to. Which named gaps from the baseline are now closed. What the student is doing before the next session, with a time estimate attached.

Two further fields matter in the investigation term: which draft stage the report has reached, and which of the four criteria the last round of feedback was about. Those two make the difference between a parent knowing the investigation is progressing and a parent discovering in March that the research question was never viable.

The reason this is worth insisting on is that it is falsifiable. A plan with a record can be shown not to be working. A plan without one cannot, and in a market where nobody publishes availability or method, a falsifiable claim is worth more than a reassuring one. Ask any Abu Dhabi tutor you speak to for an example of the record they keep, with the student's details removed.

sections.heading: Sorting a marked Biology paper into four error types
paragraphs: A returned Paper 2 with 24 out of 40 on it is not information yet. The same mark can represent four completely different students, and the hours needed to move each of them are not comparable. Sorting the lost marks is the single highest-value thing a first session can do, and it takes about twenty minutes on a paper the student has already sat.

A recall loss looks like a blank or a wrong term. The student did not know that glycolysis occurs in the cytoplasm. These are slow to fix because there is no shortcut to content, but they are honest: you can count them and watch the count fall. A command-term loss looks completely different and is the one families miss. The answer is long, accurate and fluent, and it scores two out of five because the question said evaluate and the student described. Nothing about the student's knowledge is wrong.

A data-handling loss lives in the data-based section of Paper 1 and in the structured questions that supply a graph. The signatures are specific: describing a trend the question asked to be quantified, ignoring error bars, dropping units, or reading a logarithmic axis as linear. A timing loss is the easiest of all to identify, because the losses cluster on the last page and the handwriting deteriorates.

The point of sorting is the hours estimate. Command-term repair is often four to six sessions of drilling against real mark schemes, and the gain shows up fast across every topic at once. Recall gaps across three themes are a term's work. Telling a parent which of those they are buying before they commit is what an evidence-led plan means in practice.

sections.heading: The investigation draft trail, question to final report
paragraphs: The scientific investigation is 20% of the Standard Level Biology grade and 24 marks across four criteria. It is also the only part of the course that produces dated evidence on its own, which makes it the backbone of any progress record. The sequence is predictable and each stage answers a different question for a parent.

The research question comes first and carries the most risk. Six marks sit in research design, and the other eighteen depend on whether the question can be controlled at all. A question like whether temperature affects enzyme activity is answerable; a question about whether pollution affects local marine life is not, in a school laboratory, within a term. Most mid-band reports were decided here, weeks before any data existed.

The method follows, and it is where the statistics decision actually gets made even though students think it comes later. How many repeats, at how many levels of the independent variable, with what measured how precisely, determines whether a significance test is available at the end. A tutor teaching statistics after data collection is teaching a post-mortem.

Then the first data set, then the first full report. At each of those two stages the feedback is criterion-referenced and it comments on the student's writing rather than replacing it. The dated drafts serve a second purpose beyond progress: they are a record of whose work the report is, which matters because the school supervisor's authenticity judgement is part of the assessment and the IB treats a breach as malpractice by the student.

sections.heading: What Standard Level leaves out, and what that does to the evidence
paragraphs: Standard Level Biology is not a shorter version of Higher Level in the sense of covering fewer themes. It covers the same themes with less depth and sits a shorter Paper 2. That distinction changes what the evidence looks like and it changes what a plan should prioritise.

Because there is no additional depth layer, the Standard Level content load is finishable. A student who is genuinely behind on content can be caught up inside a term, which is not reliably true at Higher Level. So a baseline that shows mostly recall losses is better news for a Standard Level student than the same baseline would be for a Higher Level one.

At the same time, the investigation is worth the identical 20%, and the papers carry the remaining 80% between a shorter Paper 2 and a Paper 1 of similar character. Proportionally, the investigation is the largest single thing a Standard Level student can move, and it is movable by work the student does rather than by content they have to absorb. An evidence-led plan for Standard Level therefore weights the draft cycle more heavily than a Higher Level plan would.

There is one decision that an evidence review often surfaces and that no tutor should make for a family: whether the student should be at Standard Level at all. A student banding consistently at 6 and intending to apply for a life-science degree may be under-placed. A student at Higher Level banding at 3 and intending to read engineering is almost certainly over-placed. Both conversations belong with the school's Diploma coordinator and university counsellor, with the marked work as the evidence.

sections.heading: What grade movement is realistic, and over what period
paragraphs: Nobody can promise a grade and any provider who does is telling you something about themselves rather than about your child. What can be described honestly is the shape of movement that evidence usually shows, and the periods over which it shows up. That is useful to a family deciding whether to continue.

Command-term repair produces the fastest visible change, because the student already knows the content and is simply answering a different question from the one asked. A run of four to six sessions against real mark schemes typically shows up in the next marked paper across several topics at once. Families often read that as a sudden improvement in knowledge. It is not; it is the same knowledge finally scoring.

Content repair is slower and more linear. Gaps across three themes take a term and the evidence of it is the named-gap list shortening rather than the grade jumping. A parent watching only the grade through that period will conclude nothing is happening, which is precisely why the named-gap list exists.

Investigation marks move in steps rather than curves, because feedback lands at discrete draft stages. The band usually moves once after the method is fixed and once after the evaluation is rewritten by the student, and then stops, because the report is submitted. Timing losses are the cheapest of all to fix and the gain is immediate. Hold all of this against the honest caveat: a student who does nothing between sessions will show none of these patterns, and the evidence will say so clearly.

sections.heading: Mock results are data, not a verdict
paragraphs: Abu Dhabi schools run mock examinations in the DP2 window and the result lands in a family's inbox with a lot of emotional weight attached. Treated as a verdict it is actively misleading. Treated as the largest single piece of evidence in the two years, it is extremely useful.

Mocks are set, marked and standardised by the school. The paper may be a past paper, a composite, or something written in-house, and the grade boundaries applied are the school's judgement. That makes the letter on the front less reliable than the pattern inside, and the pattern inside is the part almost nobody reads. A 4 built from even losses across every question means something quite different from a 4 built from a strong first half and a blank last page.

The useful exercise after a mock is not revision. It is sorting: every lost mark assigned to one of the four error types, counted, and compared with the baseline from the first diagnostic. That comparison answers the question a family actually has, which is whether the last two terms of paid hours changed anything. It usually takes one session and it determines what the remaining weeks should contain.

One further caution specific to this market. A mock grade is not a prediction and a predicted grade is a separate judgement made by the school for university applications. Neither is something a tutor issues, influences or should be asked to produce. A tutor's contribution is the error analysis and the plan that follows from it.
bullets: The pattern of losses inside a mock matters more than the letter on it
Sort every lost mark into one of the four error types before revising anything

sections.heading: Academic honesty, and why the paper trail protects the student
paragraphs: An evidence trail has a second function that families rarely consider when they ask for one. Dated drafts in the student's own words are the clearest demonstration available that the work is theirs. In a market where some providers openly sell finished reports, that record is worth having on file.

The boundary for a tutor is specific and it is worth asking any Abu Dhabi provider to state it in writing before you engage them. A tutor may teach research design. A tutor may teach the statistics. A tutor may explain precisely what each of the four criteria rewards and what the difference between a middle and a top band looks like. A tutor may read a draft the student has written and comment on it, criterion by criterion. A tutor may not supply text, supply data, or revise a draft into a submittable state.

The same applies to the Extended Essay and to Theory of Knowledge. The school supervisor keeps an authenticity record and signs off that the submitted work is the candidate's own. The IB treats a breach as malpractice by the student, with consequences that fall on the student and not on the provider who caused it. That asymmetry is the whole reason to insist on the boundary rather than take it on trust.

A related caution on materials. Syllabus documents, past papers, mark schemes and grade-boundary tables belong to the IB and to the examination boards. A tutor should reference them and point you to the official source rather than hand over copies. If a provider offers a library of downloadable mark schemes, you are looking at a copyright problem rather than a resource advantage.
bullets: Dated drafts in the student's own words evidence authorship as well as progress
A tutor teaches design and statistics, and comments on work already written
The school supervisor keeps the authenticity record for assessed work
Official syllabus and paper material should be linked, not copied or supplied

sections.heading: What to do when six weeks of evidence shows nothing moved
paragraphs: This happens, and the right response is not to buy more hours of the same thing. A record exists precisely so that this conversation can be had on facts rather than feelings, and there are only a small number of real explanations.

The first is that the diagnosis was wrong. A plan built around content gaps will not move a student whose losses were command-term errors, and six weeks of thorough content teaching will produce a thorough, unchanged mark. The fix is a re-diagnosis, which costs one session. Check the baseline list: if the named gaps are being ticked off but the marks are flat, the baseline was looking at the wrong thing.

The second is that nothing is happening between sessions. One hour a week against a course with two papers and an investigation is not sufficient on its own, and the record will show it: work set, work not done, repeatedly. That is not a tutoring problem and more tutoring will not solve it. It is worth saying plainly rather than quietly selling another term.

The third is the match. A tutor can be a competent biologist and a poor fit for a particular student, and six weeks is long enough to know. Changing tutor is a normal outcome and the baseline transfers, so the new tutor starts with a diagnosis rather than from nothing. The fourth possibility is the honest one nobody likes: the student is already performing close to their current ceiling for this term, and the useful intervention is time and the next term rather than more hours now. A provider willing to say that is more use than one who is not.
bullets: Re-diagnose before buying more hours of the same plan

sections.heading: Where the tutor pool sits in this emirate, and what is disclosed
paragraphs: Standard Level Biology is one of the more widely taught Diploma subjects, so matching is usually easier than for a narrow Higher Level specialism. Availability in Abu Dhabi is still shaped by two constraints no competitor page in this cluster mentions, and both affect what a family can realistically book.

The first is legal. Private tutoring in the UAE runs on the MoHRE private tutor work permit, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023 and granted free of charge for two years to a defined list of applicants including registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents and university students. Tutoring without it carries fines and penalties under the applicable laws. No fine schedule is published, so no figure should be quoted at you.

The second is the ADEK ethics position, reported by Gulf News, under which private and charter school staff are barred from paid private tutoring of students enrolled at their own school. Verify the current wording against ADEK's own policy before relying on it. The practical effect is to remove the most convenient option from the table and to shrink the lawful local pool.

Where no UAE-resident Standard Level Biology specialist is free for the slot a family wants, the options are stated rather than concealed: a different time, a different tutor profile, a wait with a date on it, or a tutor based outside the UAE teaching on Gulf Standard Time. Several providers ranking for UAE searches route parents to numbers outside the country without disclosing where delivery happens, and the first time a family learns that is usually the worst possible moment.
