process.title: Send one marked paper and one investigation draft
process.description: Two documents establish a baseline faster than any conversation. A marked Paper 2 question shows the error profile; a current investigation draft shows where the 20% stands. If neither exists yet, say so, and the first session generates its own baseline instead.

process.title: Take the free diagnostic session
process.description: One full session online at no charge. It should end with a written list: named gaps by theme, lost marks sorted into the four error types, a view on whether the research question is viable, and an hours estimate with reasons. Keep that document; everything later is measured against it.

process.title: Fix the slot and the reporting cadence
process.description: Agree the weekly time in Gulf Standard Time around the school run and prayer times, and agree what arrives afterwards: a short note per session and a fuller review every second week. Settle the format before the first paid hour rather than asking for it in month three.

process.title: Review at six weeks on evidence
process.description: Put the fourth fortnightly review next to the baseline. Which named gaps closed, which error type the losses moved to, which investigation criterion band shifted. Then keep the plan, change the mode, change the tutor, or stop. All four are reasonable conclusions from evidence.

process.title: Re-baseline after mocks
process.description: The mock paper is the biggest single evidence event of the two years. Sort every lost mark into an error type, compare with the original baseline, and rebuild the remaining weeks around what the comparison shows rather than around a revision timetable written in advance.

whyPoints.title: Every session leaves a written record
whyPoints.description: A short note after each session and a fuller review every second week, in the same fields each time so that the fourth can be compared with the first. The format is agreed before the first paid hour, not requested later when a family starts to worry.

whyPoints.title: Marks are sorted, not just counted
whyPoints.description: A 24 out of 40 can mean four different students. Lost marks are assigned to recall, command term, data handling or timing, because the hours needed to repair each are not comparable and a plan built on the wrong one produces thorough, unchanged results.

whyPoints.title: The investigation is handled as a draft sequence
whyPoints.description: Research question, method, first data set, first full report, each reviewed against the four published criteria. Feedback comments on the student's own writing. The dated drafts also stand as evidence of authorship, which matters to the school's authenticity record.

whyPoints.title: Stopping is a permitted outcome
whyPoints.description: If six weeks of evidence shows nothing moved, the options include re-diagnosis, a different tutor, and stopping. A diagnostic block exists precisely so some families can establish that the issue is revision habits rather than teaching and spend nothing further.

whyPoints.title: No grade promises, and no invented numbers
whyPoints.description: No provider can promise a grade or a points total. Nothing on this page carries a statistic without its source, no rating is self-asserted, and the only figures quoted are market rate bands attributed to the providers and rate tables that published them.

whyPoints.title: Delivered online, stated plainly
whyPoints.description: All Abu Dhabi lessons are one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time, including through Ramadan when slots move after Iftar. IB Gram does not offer home visits in the UAE, holds no regulator or board accreditation, and occupies no UAE premises.

faqs.question: What evidence should we have after a month of Standard Level Biology sessions?
faqs.answer: Four short session notes and two fuller fortnightly reviews, in the same fields each time. Between them they should name the content taught in syllabus wording, list the marked work reviewed with actual marks, assign each lost mark to recall, command term, data handling or timing, and tick off named gaps from the first diagnostic. In the investigation term they should also state which draft stage the report has reached. If what you have instead is four friendly messages saying the session went well, you have no evidence and no way to steer.

faqs.question: How do you tell a knowledge gap from a command-term problem on a marked paper?
faqs.answer: They look nothing alike once you know what to check. A knowledge gap shows as a blank space or a confidently wrong term. A command-term problem shows as a long, accurate, fluent answer that scores two out of five, because the question asked the student to evaluate and they described. The second is the one families miss, since the writing reads well. It is also the faster of the two to repair: four to six sessions drilled against real mark schemes usually lifts marks across several topics at once.

faqs.question: How much marked Biology work should exist before we judge whether the sessions are working?
faqs.answer: Enough to see a pattern rather than a mood, which in practice means at least three or four pieces of assessed work across six weeks, from more than one topic. One marked paper tells you about one day. Three tell you whether the losses are concentrating in the same error type. If the school is not producing enough assessed work in that period, a tutor should be setting timed questions and marking them against the official criteria so that the record exists at all.

faqs.question: Which Standard Level Biology topics come up most often in a first diagnostic?
faqs.answer: The patterns are consistent across Abu Dhabi cohorts. Cellular respiration and photosynthesis produce recall losses because the detail is sequential and partial knowledge scores poorly. Membrane transport produces quiet gaps that surface across several unrelated questions. Genetics and inheritance produce data-handling losses rather than recall ones. Ecology tends to be well recalled and badly applied. A first diagnostic is not looking for weak topics in general, though; it is looking for which of the four error types each loss belongs to.

faqs.question: Does the tutor give my daughter's investigation draft a mark?
faqs.answer: No, and you should be cautious of one who does. The mark belongs to the school, which assesses the report against the four published criteria and keeps the authenticity record. What a tutor provides is criterion-referenced feedback on the draft the student has written: which band the research design currently sits in and what specifically is missing, whether the analysis fits the data, whether the conclusion is justified rather than restated, and whether the evaluation names this method's weaknesses rather than generic ones. The student then revises in their own words.

faqs.question: How long before a grade actually moves in Standard Level Biology?
faqs.answer: It depends entirely on what is being repaired, which is why the diagnosis matters more than the hours. Command-term technique typically shows in the next marked paper after four to six sessions. Timing losses go almost immediately once full papers are sat under real conditions. Content gaps across two or three themes take a term, and through most of that term the grade will look flat while the named-gap list shortens, which is the evidence that it is working. Nobody can promise a grade, and a provider quoting one should be questioned.

faqs.question: Our Abu Dhabi school reports twice a year. Is that enough to track Biology?
faqs.answer: No. Two reports across two years means a problem can run for a full term before anyone outside the classroom sees it, and in Standard Level Biology a term is long enough to slide a band. School reports are also written for a different purpose: they summarise attainment and effort rather than diagnosing which of four error types is costing the marks. Use them as one input and run a fortnightly record alongside, built from marked work the student is already producing rather than from anything extra.

faqs.question: What does a tutor's record contain that a school report does not?
faqs.answer: Three things. First, error-type attribution: a school report says the grade, not whether the marks went to command-term misreading or to genuine recall gaps. Second, a named-gap list that gets ticked off, so the original diagnosis can be checked rather than remembered. Third, the investigation draft stage, which a school report mentions only after submission. None of that is a criticism of schools; the report is simply not built to steer a weekly plan and should not be asked to.

faqs.question: Can we see the tutor's written comments on the investigation drafts?
faqs.answer: Yes, and you should ask for them as a matter of course. Criterion-referenced feedback on a student's own draft is exactly the kind of work a parent is entitled to read, and seeing it tells you whether the comments are specific enough to act on. Comments that name the criterion, the band and the missing element are useful. Comments that say expand this are not. Keeping the dated drafts and the feedback together also supports the school's record of whose work the report is.

faqs.question: Is a mock grade of 4 in Standard Level Biology a reliable signal?
faqs.answer: The letter is less reliable than the pattern behind it. Mocks are set, marked and boundaried by the school, sometimes from a past paper and sometimes from an in-house composite, so the grade is a judgement rather than a measurement. What is reliable is the distribution of lost marks. A 4 made of even losses across every question is a content problem. A 4 with a strong first half and a blank final page is a timing problem, and those need completely different remaining weeks.

faqs.question: Does the written reporting cost extra on top of the hourly rate?
faqs.answer: It should not, and if a provider prices the record separately that tells you it is not part of how they work. The note and the fortnightly review are built from the session itself and from marked work the student already has, so they take the tutor minutes rather than hours. For context on the hourly rate itself, market bands for IB specialist tutoring in the UAE run roughly AED 200 to AED 450 according to Bestimate's 2026 rate table, with TutorChase publishing AED 270 and Unitors listing IB tuition from AED 200.

faqs.question: Do lessons happen at our apartment on Al Reem Island?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram does not offer home visits anywhere in the UAE; that is a service we run only in India. Every Abu Dhabi session is one-to-one over live video on Gulf Standard Time. For an evidence-led plan that is an advantage rather than a compromise: screen sharing puts the marked paper, the mark scheme and the annotated graph in front of both people at once, and the annotated version is saved at the end of the session instead of going home in a folder nobody opens again.

faqs.question: Is it a problem if the tutor also teaches at my daughter's Abu Dhabi school?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is worth checking before you book. Press reporting on ADEK's professional-ethics rules indicates that private and charter school staff are prohibited from providing paid private tutoring to students enrolled at their own school, and the MoHRE private tuition work permit carries a code of conduct that bars the same arrangement. Verify the current wording against ADEK's own policy document. Ask any provider directly whether the matched tutor teaches at your child's school, and expect a straight answer.

faqs.question: What should happen if six weeks of evidence shows nothing has changed?
faqs.answer: Re-diagnose rather than buy more of the same. There are four usual explanations and the record distinguishes them. The diagnosis was wrong, which shows as named gaps closing while marks stay flat. Nothing is happening between sessions, which shows as work set and not done repeatedly. The tutor is a poor fit for this student, which six weeks is long enough to establish. Or the student is near their ceiling for this term and time is the intervention. Stopping is a legitimate conclusion from evidence.

faqs.question: Which degree routes close if my child stays at Standard Level Biology?
faqs.answer: Medicine and most competitive life-science programmes expect Biology at Higher Level, and for those routes Standard Level is usually insufficient on its own regardless of the grade. Several health-science, nursing and allied programmes accept Standard Level, and requirements vary by country and by faculty rather than following a single rule. This is a question for the school's university counsellor with the actual entry requirements in front of you, not for a tutor. Tutoring is not a requirement for admission or for progression anywhere.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-biology-sl-tutor.closingHeading: Start with a baseline you can measure against
abu-dhabi/ib-dp-biology-sl-tutor.closingBody: Standard Level Biology is two papers and a 24-mark investigation, and the difference between a plan that works and one that quietly does not is whether anybody wrote down what was wrong at the start. Send one marked Paper 2 question and the current investigation draft, take the free diagnostic session online, and keep the written list it produces. Six weeks later that list is what tells you whether to continue, change the mode, change the tutor or stop. All four are reasonable, and none of them is a judgement you can make from how the sessions felt.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-business-management-home.tutorsIntro: The tutors below cover Diploma Business Management at Standard and Higher Level, including the pre-released case study and feedback cycles on a student's own research project. Each profile names the components they teach rather than a list of subjects, because that is what a parent needs in order to compare a quote against ours.

intro.heading: Start with the number, then work out what the number is buying
paragraphs: Three of the six highest-ranking tutoring pages for Abu Dhabi queries publish no price at all, and the two that do quote US dollars. That is a strange way to answer a question every parent asks in the first message. So here is the honest version. Market rates for a qualified subject tutor working online in the UAE run roughly AED 150-300 an hour, with IB and IGCSE specialists quoted between AED 200 and AED 450 and upwards. In-home visits sit higher, roughly AED 180-500, because the tutor's travel is priced into the hour whether the lesson uses it or not. Those bands come from published competitor pages and from Bestimate's Dubai tutoring rate table, and each one is attributed in the table further down.

What those figures do not tell you is why the same subject is quoted at AED 150 by one provider and AED 450 by another. For Diploma Business Management the answer is unusually clear, because the grade is assembled from three components that need three different kinds of teacher. A generalist can revise content. Only someone who has marked the subject can read a data-response answer and say which four marks were available and never claimed. And only someone who knows the research project's criteria can tell a DP2 student that a 1,800-word report with no primary data behind it has a ceiling, whatever the writing is like.

Abu Dhabi changes the arithmetic in ways Dubai does not. The emirate is spread out: the island, the Khalifa City and Al Raha corridor, the newer mainland communities at Al Shamkha and Al Falah, and then Al Ain and the Al Dhafra region a long drive away. A tutor who has to cross that geography twice for a 60-minute lesson is selling you travel at a subject-specialist rate. The emirate also closes the cheapest route that Dubai parents sometimes take: press-reported ADEK professional-ethics rules bar private and charter school staff from taking paid private tutoring work with students enrolled at their own school, and the MoHRE private tuition work permit carries a code of conduct that says the same. Verify the current wording against ADEK's own policy document before you rely on it, but plan on the assumption that your child's own class teacher is not available privately.

The rest of this page is a cost argument with the numbers shown. It sets out what the market charges and who published each figure, what travel adds to an hour in this emirate, which of the three Business Management components is worth paying a specialist premium for, and what a two-year Diploma support budget looks like beside a school-fee bill. It also says plainly where a tutor has to stop. IB Gram does not offer home visits in Abu Dhabi or anywhere else in the UAE; home visits are a service we run only in India. Every UAE lesson is one-to-one online over live video, and the case for that is made on cost and on tutor choice rather than on convenience.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-business-management-home.programmesIntro: Business Management sits at Diploma level, but the money question usually arrives earlier, when a family is budgeting across a whole programme. These are the stages an Abu Dhabi family is actually paying for, and what each one costs in tutoring terms rather than in school fees.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: The two years where Business Management is examined. Standard and Higher Level share the same five content units and the same internally assessed research project; Higher Level sits a longer first paper and a wider set of extended-response demands. Tutoring here is the most expensive band in the market because the teacher has to know the mark scheme, not only the content.
programmes.countryNote: Abu Dhabi Diploma cohorts are often small. A school may run one Business Management class across both years, with a single teacher covering Standard and Higher Level together. That is where private support stops being optional for a student aiming above a 5, and it is also why specialist rates hold firm in this emirate even when general tutoring rates soften.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: Individuals and Societies in the Middle Years Programme is where the habits that decide a Business Management grade are formed, or not formed. Students learn to describe rather than to apply, and the criteria reward structured argument long before Diploma does. Rates here sit lower, closer to the AED 150-250 band, because the marking load is lighter.
programmes.countryNote: Abu Dhabi families moving from a Middle Years Programme into Diploma Business Management often buy the wrong thing first: content revision, when the gap is applying a tool to a named organisation. Six hours of targeted work in the summer before DP1 costs less than a term of weekly sessions in DP2 and usually buys more.

programmes.name: The Diploma core: IA, EE and TOK
programmes.description: The business research project, an Extended Essay in Business Management, and the Theory of Knowledge requirement all land in the same months. Families frequently budget for subject lessons and then discover the coursework block separately. Coursework support is priced by the hour in the same specialist band, and it is almost always bought in a short scoped block rather than weekly.
programmes.countryNote: Deadlines in Abu Dhabi schools cluster around the long weekends and the Eid breaks, so the coursework block has to be booked earlier than a family expects. Plan the research-project hours against your school's internal deadline, not against the external session, because the internal date is usually months ahead.

programmes.name: Career-related Programme
programmes.description: A smaller presence in the emirate, but it exists, and it pairs Diploma courses with a career-related study. Families comparing it against the full Diploma often ask whether the Business Management tutoring they are buying transfers. The subject content does; the core requirements and the reflective project do not, and they are priced separately.
programmes.countryNote: Where an Abu Dhabi school offers the Career-related Programme alongside the Diploma, the Business Management course taken within it is the same Diploma course. A quote for one should look like a quote for the other. If it does not, ask the provider which components they have actually taught.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-business-management-home.subjectsIntro: Business Management is rarely the only line in the budget. These are the Diploma subjects Abu Dhabi families most often pair with it, with a note on what each one actually assesses, because the assessment is what sets the rate.

subjects.name: Business Management
subjects.description: Five content units, two written papers and an internally assessed research project worth a quarter of the grade. The first paper is built on a case study the IB releases in advance. Marks are lost on tools applied without a named organisation behind them, and on recommendations that do not weigh a cost against a benefit.

subjects.name: Economics
subjects.description: Microeconomics, macroeconomics, the global economy and an internally assessed portfolio of commentaries on published news articles. Diagram accuracy carries real marks, and most lost marks sit in explanation rather than in the drawing. Rates track Business Management closely because the marking demand is similar.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
subjects.description: The route most Business Management students take. Statistics, financial mathematics and modelling, with a technology-permitted paper. The exploration is marked against the same criteria set as every other mathematics exploration, and students underestimate the mathematical rigour it needs.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
subjects.description: The algebra-heavy route, taken by Business Management students aiming at economics or finance degrees that specify it. Proof, calculus and a non-calculator paper. Check the admissions pages of the universities on your child's list before switching, because the requirement varies by course rather than by institution.

subjects.name: Psychology
subjects.description: Three approaches to behaviour, an option topic, and an experimental study written up against four criteria. The pairing with Business Management is common in Abu Dhabi schools because both reward structured argument. Marks go missing in the critical-thinking strand rather than in recall.

subjects.name: Global Politics
subjects.description: Core political concepts examined through a source booklet and extended responses, with an engagement project behind a written report. Students who argue well in conversation still score mid-band because they do not anchor a claim to a concept and a case.

subjects.name: English A: Language and Literature
subjects.description: Non-literary and literary texts, a paper of unseen analysis, an individual oral and, at Higher Level, an essay on a studied work. The analysis paper is where a Business Management student's habit of summarising rather than analysing costs the most.

subjects.name: Geography
subjects.description: Core units on population, climate vulnerability and resource security, optional themes, and a fieldwork report with a word ceiling. Shares with Business Management a dependence on named case material; a general answer about a general place scores in the lowest band.

subjects.name: History
subjects.description: A source-based paper, comparative essays, a Higher Level regional option and a 2,200-word historical investigation. Pairs with Business Management in Abu Dhabi humanities blocks, and the two share one failure mode: assertion without evidence attached.

subjects.name: Computer Science
subjects.description: Computational thinking, program design in the IB's own pseudocode, and a solution developed for a real client with documentation attached. Chosen alongside Business Management by students heading for information-systems or analytics degrees.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-business-management-home.regionsIntro: Delivery is online, so the area a family lives in does not change availability. It does change what an in-home quote would cost, and it changes what time a session can realistically start. These are the Abu Dhabi communities the cost question comes from most often.

regions.name: Al Reem Island
regions.note: Dense apartment living with schools a short causeway away, so the in-home premium here is the smallest in the emirate. Evening slots still compete with the bridge traffic back onto the island, which is why a 4.30pm online start is easier to hold than an in-home one.

regions.name: Al Maryah Island
regions.note: Mostly professional households with Diploma students bussed off-island to school. Families here tend to compare a provider's hourly rate against the monthly package rates circulating in the market, and the package maths only works if the sessions are actually used.

regions.name: Khalifa City
regions.note: A villa belt with a long internal road network, so an in-home tutor charges for the distance between two addresses that look close on a map. Several of the emirate's Diploma cohorts sit in or near this corridor, which concentrates demand for the same evening hours.

regions.name: Al Raha Beach

sections.heading: What Diploma Business Management support costs in the Abu Dhabi market
paragraphs: A qualified subject tutor working online in the UAE is quoted between roughly AED 150 and AED 300 an hour. An IB or IGCSE specialist sits between roughly AED 200 and AED 450 and upwards. An in-home visit runs roughly AED 180-500 because travel is inside the hour. Those are market bands, read from published provider pages and from Bestimate's Dubai rate table in October 2026, not an IB Gram price list.

The band a Business Management quote lands in depends almost entirely on what the hour includes. At the lower end you are buying lesson time: the tutor explains a unit, sets a question, and the student marks their own work or nobody does. At the specialist end the hour includes a script read against the published criteria, a written comment that names the marks available and not claimed, and a plan that says which component the next three sessions attack. The gap between those two products is larger than the gap between the prices.

Monthly packages circulating in the market tell the same story from another angle. AED 799 a month for eight online sessions works out near the bottom of the qualified-tutor band per hour, and it assumes all eight sessions are used. In-home packages recorded at AED 1,599-1,799 a month for four two-hour sessions price the tutor's travel four times over. Before comparing any package against an hourly quote, divide it out and ask what happens to an unused session.

One number is not negotiable in either direction: the MoHRE private tuition work permit is granted free of charge for two years. If a provider adds a licensing or registration fee to your invoice, ask what it is for. The permit itself carries no charge, and the official route to it is MoHRE's own private tutor licensing service.

sections.heading: Why the in-home premium is larger in Abu Dhabi than in Dubai
paragraphs: Abu Dhabi is a long emirate. The Diploma schools sit mainly on the island, on Saadiyat, and along the Khalifa City to Al Raha corridor, while a large share of the families who want Business Management support live in the newer mainland communities or out towards Al Ain and the Al Dhafra region. A tutor driving between those two maps twice for one 60-minute lesson is selling an hour of teaching and two hours of car.

That arithmetic is why in-home quotes in this emirate arrive with conditions attached far more often than in Dubai: a two-hour minimum booking, a weekend-only slot, a surcharge that is described as a travel allowance, or a flat refusal for an address beyond a stated radius. None of those are unreasonable. They are what the distance costs. They are also, measured per hour of teaching actually received, the largest avoidable line in an Abu Dhabi tutoring budget.

Online removes the line rather than discounting it. A family in Al Shamkha and a family in Al Bateen are quoted the same hour, and both choose from the same pool of Business Management specialists instead of from whoever is willing to drive. For a subject with three distinct components and a small teaching population in the emirate, that pool difference is worth more than the money saved.

To be explicit about what we do and do not sell: IB Gram does not send a tutor to an Abu Dhabi address. Home visits are a service we run only in India, and no sentence on this site should be read as promising otherwise. What we deliver in this emirate is scheduled, one-to-one, live-video tuition on Gulf Standard Time, with the screen shared both ways so a student's working is visible while it is being written.

sections.heading: The ADEK rule that closes the cheapest route in this emirate
paragraphs: A route some families try first is to ask a teacher at their child's own school for paid private lessons. In Abu Dhabi, plan on that being closed. Press reporting on ADEK's professional-ethics rules for private and charter school staff describes a prohibition on providing paid private tutoring to students enrolled at the teacher's own school, and the MoHRE private tuition work permit carries a code of conduct described in the same terms. Because this is press-reported rather than quoted from the policy document here, verify the current wording with ADEK directly before relying on it.

The underlying federal position is clearer and worth knowing in full. Private tutoring in the UAE is regulated by permit. The MoHRE private tutor work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, it is granted free of charge for two years, and the eligible categories include teachers registered in government or private schools, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students, and school students aged 15 to 18. Individuals offering private tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws. No fine schedule is published, so no figure should be quoted to you as fact.

What this means for a budget is simple. The informally cheap option in this emirate is usually also the non-compliant one, and the saving is not worth the position it puts a teacher in. A permitted independent tutor, an agency, a tuition centre with premises and the correct KHDA or emirate-level permit, and an online platform are the four legitimate shapes. They price differently, and the comparison table in the market-rate section is drawn across models rather than across brands for exactly that reason.

One further distinction matters. An individual tutor needs the MoHRE permit. An operation with premises and staff in Dubai needs a KHDA Educational Services Permit for a training institute, which is a different instrument with its own renewal cycle. IB Gram holds no regulator approval, accreditation or licence from ADEK, KHDA, SPEA, the Ministry of Education, the IB, Cambridge or Pearson, and claims none. We name those bodies to explain what they govern, nothing more.

sections.heading: What the specialist premium is actually buying across three components
paragraphs: Business Management is assessed through two written papers and one internally assessed business research project. The research project carries a quarter of the final grade and has an 1,800-word ceiling. The first written paper is built on a case study the IB releases to schools in advance. The second is a data-response paper. The precise durations and the split between the two papers differ between Standard and Higher Level and between guide versions, so confirm your child's exact weightings with the school's Diploma coordinator rather than taking a figure from any tutoring page, including this one.

Those three components fail in three different ways, and that is the real argument for paying a specialist rate for some hours and a lower rate for others. Content gaps across the five units are the cheapest problem to fix and the one a competent generalist handles well. Application failure on the data-response paper is middling: it needs someone who can read an answer and name the marks that were available. Research-project failure is the expensive one, because by the time a weak project is visible in a draft the primary research behind it may already be unusable.

The pattern a marker sees most often is a tool deployed without an organisation attached. A student writes a textbook-perfect account of what a particular planning tool does, applies it to nothing, and scores in the lower band. The fix is not more content. It is a drill: every tool, every time, anchored to a named organisation in the case material with a number attached and a limitation acknowledged. That drill is cheap to run and it moves marks faster than anything else in this subject.

The second pattern is the recommendation that does not weigh anything. Extended responses in this subject ask for a judgement, and a judgement needs a cost set against a benefit and a condition under which the answer would change. Students who write fluent description and then stop one sentence short of the judgement lose the top band on every long answer on the paper. Both patterns are diagnosable from one marked script, which is why the first thing a sensible engagement produces is a marked script rather than a lesson plan.
bullets: Content gaps: cheapest to fix, and a generalist can do it
Data-response application: needs a reader who knows the criteria
Research project: the expensive failure, because it is discovered late
Every tool anchored to a named organisation, with a number and a limitation

sections.heading: A two-year Diploma support budget beside an Abu Dhabi school-fee bill
paragraphs: Families rarely overspend on tutoring because the hourly rate was wrong. They overspend because the hours were bought in the wrong shape and at the wrong time. A weekly hour running from the first week of DP1 to the May session of DP2 is around seventy hours of tuition. At the mid band that is a substantial figure, and a large share of those hours will land in weeks when the student had nothing to work on.

The alternative shape costs less and usually achieves more: a diagnostic engagement of two or three hours early in DP1 to establish where the student actually sits, a scoped block against whichever component the diagnosis names, a research-project block timed to the school's internal deadline rather than to the external one, and a case-study intensive before the written papers. That is perhaps thirty to forty hours across two years, concentrated where the marks are.

The context figure worth holding alongside it is the school fee. KHDA confirmed in May 2026 that there would be no increase in private school fees in Dubai for the 2026-27 academic year under the emirate's second economic incentives package. Abu Dhabi fee regulation sits with ADEK and operates on its own cycle, so check your own school's position. The point for budgeting is that tutoring is the variable line in an education budget and the fee is the fixed one, which makes tutoring the line families cut first and the one they should plan most carefully.

sections.heading: The pre-released case study and what it does to the price curve
paragraphs: One feature of this subject distorts demand across the whole emirate at the same moment. The first written paper is built on a case study the IB releases to schools ahead of the examination. Every Business Management cohort in Abu Dhabi receives it within the same window, every teacher begins working through it at once, and every family that decides it needs help decides so in the same fortnight.

The consequence is predictable. Specialist availability in this subject thins sharply in the weeks after the release, and the slots that remain are the ones nobody wants: late evenings, early mornings, weekend afternoons. Families who book in that fortnight are choosing from what is left rather than from who is right, and that is a worse outcome than paying slightly more earlier.

The work itself rewards early preparation in a specific way. A released case study is a finite document, and the marks come from knowing the organisation in it well enough to apply any tool to it without re-reading. Students who treat it as revision material to be skimmed before the paper score what skimming earns. Students who build a working knowledge of the organisation's numbers, stakeholders and constraints over a term can answer a question they have not seen on material they know cold.

Practically, that means the useful conversation about case-study support happens before the release rather than after it. Ask the school's Diploma coordinator when the material is expected. Book the intensive against that date. And treat anybody offering a pre-written set of model answers to a released case study with suspicion, because a handed-over answer is both worthless in the examination hall and a route into an academic-honesty investigation.

Book the intensive before the release, not in the fortnight after it

sections.heading: Academic honesty in the research project, and the one cost never worth paying
paragraphs: There is a visible market in this region for finished Diploma coursework. One site in the research set sells completed internal assessments outright. For an Abu Dhabi family weighing a budget, this needs stating without euphemism: buying assessed work is academic malpractice under the IB's own rules, the consequence falls on the student rather than on the seller, and the saving is not a saving.

What a tutor is permitted to do with a business research project is substantial and worth paying for. A tutor may teach the research methods the project needs, explain what each assessment criterion is asking for in plain language, question the choice of organisation and research question before any data is collected, read a student's own draft and comment on it, point out where a claim is unevidenced, and ask the questions that make a student revise their own work. All of that is teaching.

What a tutor may not do is produce any part of the assessed work. No tutor should supply text for a project, rewrite a section into its final form, select and summarise the sources so the student need not read them, or generate the analysis the student is supposed to perform. A tutor who offers any of that is offering something that can end a Diploma. The boundary is not subtle and a good tutor will state it to you unprompted.

Ask any provider in this emirate for their written position on coursework before you book, and read the answer carefully. A provider who answers in general terms about integrity while describing a service that produces drafts is telling you something. A provider who says plainly which actions they will refuse has given you the single most useful piece of information available for comparing quotes.
bullets: A tutor teaches method, questions choices and comments on the student's own draft

sections.heading: Testing a quote, and what happens when nobody local is free
paragraphs: Four questions separate a quote worth paying from one that is not, and none of them is about price. First: which Business Management component will the first three sessions attack, and how was that decided? A tutor who answers before seeing any of your child's work is guessing. Second: is marking inside the hourly rate or billed separately? Third: what will be handed back in writing after each session? Fourth: at what point will you tell us this is not working?

The fourth question is the one that matters most and the one almost nobody asks. A provider with no mechanism for recommending less tutoring has an incentive problem. A six-week review that can end in a recommendation to stop is worth more to a family than a discount, because the largest cost in this market is not the hourly rate. It is hours bought for a term that stopped being useful in week three.

On availability, the honest position. The Diploma Business Management teaching population inside the UAE is small, and in a given week there may be no Abu Dhabi-based specialist free at the hour your family needs. Where that happens, we say so and offer the slot with a tutor based elsewhere who teaches the same specification, at the same rate, on Gulf Standard Time. No competitor in the researched set discloses a coverage limit at all; several conceal non-UAE delivery behind an overseas phone number.

If a component is genuinely not covered at the level your child needs, the useful answer is a referral rather than a booking. A family that is told plainly that we cannot staff a Higher Level slot this term has lost nothing. A family sold a generalist at specialist rates has lost a term and the money. That trade-off is the whole argument for reading a cost page before a sales page.

process.title: Send the evidence, not the worry
process.description: A marked Business Management script, the most recent report comment and your school's internal coursework deadline tell us more in two minutes than a long description of the problem. Families who send work get a specific answer about which component to attack; families who send a worry get a general one.

process.title: A free trial lesson with the tutor who would teach
process.description: Not a sales call and not a different tutor from the one who would hold the slot. The trial is held with the papers open, and it ends with a statement of which component the first block should target and why. If that statement is vague, do not book the block.

process.title: Agree the block, the rate and the review date
process.description: Hours, not terms. You agree how many hours, what each session will hand back in writing, what is included in the rate, and the date at which somebody will say whether it is working. All four in writing before any money moves.

process.title: Written work marked between sessions
process.description: A session that does not produce something marked has produced a conversation. Each block sets written work against the published criteria, returns it with a comment naming the marks available and not claimed, and uses the next session to close the gap the comment identified.

process.title: Review at six weeks, including the option to stop
process.description: At six weeks the marked scripts either show movement or they do not. Where they do not, the recommendation may be a different tutor, a different component, or no tutoring at all. A review that can only ever recommend continuing is not a review.

whyPoints.title: A stated position on assessed work

A provider that cannot recommend fewer hours is not advising you, and the largest waste in this market is hours that stopped being useful in week three.

faqs.question: What does a Diploma Business Management tutor charge per hour in Abu Dhabi?
faqs.answer: Market rates for a qualified subject tutor working online in the UAE run roughly AED 150-300 an hour, with IB specialists quoted from about AED 200 to AED 450 and upwards. In-home visits sit higher, roughly AED 180-500, because travel is priced inside the hour. Those bands come from published provider pages and Bestimate's Dubai rate table, read in October 2026, and they are the market rather than our price list. What actually separates a quote at the bottom of a band from one at the top is whether marking, criteria-referenced written feedback and a component plan are included in the hour or billed on top of it.

faqs.question: Why is the in-home rate higher in Abu Dhabi than the online rate?
faqs.answer: Because the drive is inside the fee. The Diploma schools cluster on the island, Saadiyat and the Khalifa City to Al Raha corridor, while a lot of demand comes from Al Shamkha, Al Falah, Mussafah and further out. A 25 to 40 kilometre each-way journey adds an hour or more of unpaid time to a 60-minute lesson, so quotes arrive with two-hour minimums, travel allowances or radius limits attached. Those conditions are not unreasonable; they are what the distance costs. Measured per hour of teaching actually received, they are the biggest avoidable line in an Abu Dhabi tutoring budget.

faqs.question: Can a teacher at my child's Abu Dhabi school tutor them privately for pay?
faqs.answer: Plan on no. Press reporting on ADEK's professional-ethics rules for private and charter school staff describes a prohibition on paid private tutoring of students enrolled at the teacher's own school, and the MoHRE private tuition work permit carries a code of conduct described in similar terms. Because that is press-reported rather than quoted here from the policy document, confirm the current wording with ADEK before relying on it. The practical effect is that the informally cheapest route in this emirate is usually also the non-compliant one, and it puts the teacher rather than the family at risk.

faqs.question: Does a quoted rate include marking my child's business research project drafts?
faqs.answer: Ask, because this is where quotes diverge most. At the lower end of the market the hour is lesson time and nothing is marked. At the specialist end the rate includes reading a draft against the published assessment criteria and returning a written comment that names which marks were available and not claimed. Some providers bill coursework feedback as a separate product at a separate rate. Neither approach is wrong, but comparing a rate that includes marking against one that does not makes the cheaper quote look better than it is by a wide margin.

faqs.question: How many hours of Business Management support does a DP2 student usually need?
faqs.answer: Fewer than a weekly slot across two years implies, and in a different shape. A useful pattern is two or three diagnostic hours to establish where the student sits, a scoped block of six to ten hours against whichever component the diagnosis names, a separate block timed to the school's internal research-project deadline, and a short intensive before the written papers. That is roughly thirty to forty hours across the Diploma rather than seventy. The saving is real, but the reason to prefer it is that the hours land where marks are actually available.

faqs.question: Is the pre-released case study worth booking extra hours for?
faqs.answer: For most students, yes, and earlier than feels necessary. The first written paper is built on material the IB releases to schools in advance, so every Abu Dhabi cohort receives it in the same window and specialist availability thins sharply in the fortnight afterwards. The marks come from knowing the organisation well enough to apply any tool without re-reading, which takes weeks rather than days. Ask your Diploma coordinator when the release is expected and book against that date. Treat any offer of pre-written model answers as a reason to walk away.

faqs.question: What is the word limit on the business research project?
faqs.answer: The business research project has an 1,800-word ceiling, and it carries a quarter of the subject grade. That combination is what makes it the most expensive component to fix late: by the time a weak project is visible in a draft, the primary research behind it may already be unusable, and no amount of rewriting inside 1,800 words will rescue a question that cannot be answered with the data collected. Confirm the exact requirements and your school's internal deadline with the Diploma coordinator, since internal dates usually sit months ahead of anything external.

faqs.question: Can a tutor choose the research project topic and organisation for my child?
faqs.answer: No, and a tutor who offers to is offering a problem. What a tutor can properly do is question a choice before any data is collected: is this organisation accessible, will the research question survive contact with real data, is the method one a student can actually run, and does the chosen focus let the student hit every criterion? That questioning is the highest-value hour in the whole component. The decision, the data collection and every word of the report have to be the student's own, and the consequence of the alternative falls on the student.

faqs.question: Which Business Management component should we spend on first?
faqs.answer: Whichever one a marked script says is losing marks, which is why the first thing a sensible engagement produces is a marked script rather than a lesson plan. In practice two patterns dominate. The first is a tool explained correctly and applied to nothing, which scores in the lower band regardless of how well it is written. The second is an extended response that describes fluently and then stops one sentence short of a judgement weighing a cost against a benefit. Both are diagnosable from one script and both move quickly once named.

faqs.question: Do tutoring rates in this emirate rise in the weeks before the May session?
faqs.answer: The published bands do not move much, but availability does, and availability behaves like a price. In the weeks after the case study is released and again in the run-up to the May session, the specialists are booked and the slots left over are the awkward ones. Families booking late end up choosing from who is free rather than from who is right, which costs more than a higher hourly rate would. The practical advice is to book the exam-season block a term early and to expect the useful hours to be gone by the time the pressure is obvious.

faqs.question: Does a private tutor working in Abu Dhabi need a permit, and does it cost anything?
faqs.answer: Yes to the permit and no to the cost. Private tutoring in the UAE is regulated: the MoHRE private tutor work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, and it is granted free of charge for two years. Eligible categories include school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. Anyone tutoring without a permit is subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws, though no fine schedule is published, so treat any specific figure quoted at you as unverified.

faqs.question: Is the AED range shown here what IB Gram charges for Business Management?
faqs.answer: No. Every band here is a market figure read from a named published source in October 2026: provider pages that publish their own rates, and Bestimate's Dubai tutoring rate table. They are on the page because three of the six highest-ranking competitor pages publish no price at all and the two that do quote US dollars, which is not a currency UAE families transact in. What IB Gram charges is discussed after a free trial lesson with the tutor who would hold the slot, because a rate quoted before anyone has seen the student's work is a guess.

faqs.question: What happens if no Abu Dhabi-based Business Management specialist is free at our hour?
faqs.answer: We say so, and offer the slot with a tutor based elsewhere who teaches the same specification, at the same rate, scheduled on Gulf Standard Time. The Diploma Business Management teaching population inside the UAE is genuinely small, and in a given week there may be nobody free at 5pm on a Tuesday. Where a component cannot be covered at the level your child needs, the right answer is to say the slot is unavailable rather than substitute a generalist at a specialist rate. No competitor in the researched set discloses a coverage limit at all.

faqs.question: Can Business Management sessions move to post-Iftar timing during Ramadan?
faqs.answer: Yes, and most families in this emirate ask for it. School hours shorten during Ramadan, the useful study window shifts late, and a 4.30pm slot that worked in January is the worst possible hour in March. Because delivery is online there is no travel to rearrange, so moving a standing slot to after Iftar is a calendar change rather than a renegotiation. The same applies to the long weekends and the Eid breaks, which is when internal coursework deadlines in Abu Dhabi schools tend to cluster and when a scoped block earns its place.

faqs.question: Do we pay for the trial lesson, and what conditions apply to it?
faqs.answer: The trial lesson is free, it is held with the tutor who would actually hold the weekly slot rather than a consultant, and it carries no obligation to book anything afterwards. The condition worth stating is what it is for: the tutor looks at your child's marked work during it and ends by naming which component the first block should attack and why. If that closing statement is vague, the honest conclusion is not to book the block. A trial that cannot produce a specific recommendation has told you something useful anyway.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-business-management-home.closingHeading: Get the number, then decide what to buy with it
abu-dhabi/ib-dp-business-management-home.closingBody: Send one marked Business Management script, your school's internal research-project deadline, and the hour of the week that would actually work. We will come back with which component the evidence points at, whether a specialist rate is justified for it, and whether a scoped block or a weekly slot is the cheaper way to buy it. The trial lesson that follows is free and is held with the tutor who would teach. Every lesson is one-to-one online over live video on Gulf Standard Time; we do not run home visits in the UAE. If we cannot staff what your child needs, you will be told that rather than sold something adjacent to it.

intro.heading: Three moments Abu Dhabi families buy Business Management support, and what each costs
paragraphs: Business Management is bought reactively, and the trigger is almost always one of three events. The pre-released case study arrives and nobody in the house understands what to do with it. The business research project has a deadline and a word count and no research question that works. Or finance and accounts turns up in the second term and a student who was comfortable with marketing and human resources suddenly is not. Each of those is a different purchase with a different number of hours attached, and the hourly rate is the least variable part of the calculation.

On the rate itself: market rates for IB specialist tutoring in the UAE run roughly AED 200 to AED 450 an hour, which is the band in Bestimate's Tutoring Cost Dubai 2026 table. TutorChase publishes AED 270. Unitors lists IB tuition from AED 200 and IGCSE from AED 150. BartyED publishes AED 650 for its examiner tier. The entry tiers advertised from AED 33 to AED 65 by Tutopiya and EdFlik are university-student and group formats, which is a genuinely different product and should not be lined up against a Diploma specialist on price.

The pre-released case study is the most distinctive cost event in this subject and the one no competitor page prices. Schools receive it in advance of the examination, which means a family has months of lead time, not weeks. It is also the one component where a small group can be reasonable value, because the case is identical for every candidate in the world and much of the preparatory work is shared analysis rather than individual diagnosis. That is a real saving and it is worth saying out loud on a page that otherwise argues for one-to-one.

The research project is the largest single block of hours. It carries 25% of the subject grade at both levels, runs to a maximum of 1,800 words, and requires a real organisation and a genuine research question. The hours are front-loaded into question design and source planning, exactly like a science investigation, and for the same reason: a question that cannot be answered with the material available produces a project that cannot score, no matter how well it is written later.

The fourth cost input is local and legal. ADEK supervises the licensing and accreditation of Abu Dhabi private schools, and Gulf News reported that its professional-ethics rules bar school staff from paid private tutoring of students enrolled at their own school. The MoHRE private tutor work permit, introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is granted free of charge for two years and carries a code of conduct saying the same. The lawful pool in this emirate is therefore smaller than the number of Business teachers in it. IB Gram does not send a tutor to a UAE address; home visits are a service we run only in India, and every Abu Dhabi lesson runs online over live video.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-business-management-tuto.programmesIntro: Business Management sits in Group 3 of the Diploma and is taken at both levels, which is why this page covers both. The routes below change what a student arrives with and therefore what the first term of support has to cover.

programmes.name: Diploma Programme
programmes.description: Six subjects over two years plus Theory of Knowledge, the Extended Essay and CAS. Business Management runs across five units and a toolkit of analytical techniques. Standard Level sits two papers plus the research project; Higher Level adds a third paper built on an unseen case about a social enterprise. The research project carries 25% at both levels, which is unusual among Diploma subjects and shifts where the hours go.
programmes.countryNote: In Abu Dhabi, Business Management competes with Economics for the same Group 3 choosers, and at several schools it is the larger of the two. Class sizes at the island schools can reach twenty, while newer mainland schools may run a group of six. Group size matters here more than in most subjects, because the pre-released case study rewards shared discussion and a group of six produces much less of it.

programmes.name: Middle Years Programme
programmes.description: Individuals and Societies in MYP assesses knowing and understanding, investigating, communicating and thinking critically. The investigating criterion is the closest existing preparation for the business research project, since both require a question, a plan and evidence gathered against it. What MYP does not provide is any accounting or quantitative business content.
programmes.countryNote: Students arriving in DP1 from an MYP stream at an Abu Dhabi IB school typically write confident analysis and meet balance sheets for the first time in the second term. Families budgeting for support should expect the finance and accounts block rather than general content teaching, and should expect to need it at a predictable point in the year.

programmes.name: Career-related Programme
programmes.description: Pairs a small number of DP courses with a career-related study and a reflective project. Business Management is one of the commonest DP courses taken inside a CP, and the student sits the same papers and submits the same research project. The career-related study sometimes supplies the organisation the research project needs, which is a practical advantage.
programmes.countryNote: The Career-related Programme is uncommon in Abu Dhabi but Business Management is its most natural DP subject. A CP student frequently has a workplace connection through the career-related study, which solves the hardest logistical problem in the research project: finding an organisation willing to supply enough information to answer a real question.

programmes.name: Theory of Knowledge and the Extended Essay
programmes.description: An Extended Essay in Business Management is a separate 4,000-word piece supervised at school, distinct from the research project and with its own authenticity record. A student doing both has two independent research pieces in the same subject, which is heavier than it sounds and needs planning in DP1 rather than discovering in DP2.
programmes.countryNote: Abu Dhabi schools generally set internal core deadlines ahead of the IB's own windows. Where a student is writing both an Extended Essay and the research project in Business Management, the two internal deadlines often sit within the same term, and that collision is the single commonest reason a family's monthly spend doubles unplanned.

abu-dhabi/ib-dp-business-management-tuto.subjectsIntro: Business Management is the subject here, described at both levels. The subjects after it are the ones Abu Dhabi students pair it with, each noted for what the combination does to the number of hours a family buys.

subjects.name: Business Management (Higher Level)
subjects.description: Three papers plus the research project. Paper 1 is built on the pre-released case study, Paper 2 on unseen scenarios with a substantial quantitative element, and Paper 3 on an unseen case concerning a social enterprise. The Higher Level toolkit is wider, and Paper 3 asks for a recommendation rather than an analysis, which is a different skill and a separate block of hours.

subjects.name: Business Management (Standard Level)
subjects.description: Two papers plus the same research project at the same 25%. Paper 1 carries a larger share of the Standard Level grade than it does at Higher Level, which makes pre-released case study preparation proportionally more valuable for a Standard Level candidate than for a Higher Level one.

subjects.name: Economics
subjects.description: The usual Group 3 alternative rather than a companion, though some Abu Dhabi students take both. Market structures and some demand analysis overlap; the assessment styles do not. Two separate tutors is normally the honest answer, and that doubles the weekly spend.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation
subjects.description: Supplies the quantitative base finance and accounts needs: ratios, break-even, descriptive statistics, investment appraisal arithmetic. A student taking Applications usually needs transfer coaching rather than teaching, which is a cheaper purchase than it first appears.

subjects.name: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
subjects.description: Produces students who can do the arithmetic and have never seen it presented as a cash flow forecast or a contribution calculation. The gap is recognition rather than capability, and it closes in a small number of sessions once the format is familiar.

subjects.name: Digital Society
subjects.description: Overlaps Business Management on technology adoption, data and organisational change. Students taking both can be taught the shared ground once, and the inquiry habits of Digital Society transfer into the research project's methodology section.

subjects.name: Global Politics
subjects.description: Shares stakeholder analysis, governance and ethics content. It trains students to weigh competing interests, which is exactly what a Paper 2 evaluation and a Paper 3 recommendation require and what most Business answers lack.

subjects.name: English A: Language and Literature
subjects.description: Business Management is a written subject with a word-limited research project. Where marks are being lost to structure, concision and unsupported assertion rather than to business knowledge, the problem belongs here and should be diagnosed as such rather than paid for as business tuition.

subjects.name: Extended Essay in Business Management
subjects.description: Separate from the research project and supervised at school. A tutor can teach research method, question framing and source evaluation, and comment on drafts the student has written. The text must be the student's own, and the school supervisor records authenticity as part of the assessment.

subjects.name: Theory of Knowledge
subjects.description: Shares no content and competes directly for the weeks when the research project is due at most Abu Dhabi schools. An honest two-year cost plan has to account for the term in which a weekly business hour is unaffordable in time rather than in money.

sections.heading: Costing Business Management by the three things families actually buy
paragraphs: A single hourly rate tells an Abu Dhabi family almost nothing about what Business Management support will cost them, because the three jobs they might be buying consume wildly different numbers of hours. Pricing by component is the only version of this question with a useful answer.

Finance and accounts is the most predictable purchase and the best value. It is mechanical, it is bounded, and the marks are recoverable: ratio interpretation, break-even, cash flow forecasting and investment appraisal are all procedures that can be taught and then practised. Four to six sessions covers it for most students, and the effect appears in both papers and often in the research project as well.

The pre-released case study is the longest-running engagement and the one with the most flexible cost, because it is the only component where sharing a session is defensible. Every candidate in the world receives the same case. Much of the preparation is context analysis and anticipation of question areas, and two or three students doing that together produce better discussion than one student doing it alone. A family choosing a shared session for this component and one-to-one for everything else is making a sensible decision rather than a cheap one.

The research project is the largest block and the one where buying late costs the most. The hours are front-loaded into finding an organisation and framing a question the available information can answer. Those hours bought early are planning; bought after a question has been approved and the information turns out not to exist, they are rescue, and rescue takes longer and achieves less. sections.heading: The pre-released case study, and the one place group tuition is good value
paragraphs: Paper 1 in Business Management is built on a case study issued to schools ahead of the examination. That single fact makes this subject different from every other Group 3 course in how support should be bought, and no competitor page measured in this research set addresses it.

The practical consequence is lead time. A family that starts case study preparation when the case arrives has months. A family that starts six weeks before the paper has six weeks, at the point in the year when evening slots across the emirate are scarcest and most expensive in opportunity terms. Nothing about the case changes in that period. Only the amount of preparation possible does.

The second consequence is that sharing works here. Every candidate sits the same case, so the groundwork is common: understanding the organisation, mapping its context, identifying which of the five units the case touches, anticipating which toolkit techniques the examiners are likely to invite, and building the stakeholder analysis the paper assumes rather than states. Two or three students working through that together generate the kind of argument a single student cannot have with themselves, and the cost per family falls accordingly.

What does not transfer to a shared format is individual mark repair. Your child's particular habit of asserting rather than justifying, their specific weakness in applying a tool properly, their own timing problem on the final question: none of that survives being taught to three people at once. The sensible Abu Dhabi plan for most families is a shared case study block alongside one-to-one work on whatever the marked papers show, and a provider should be willing to structure it that way rather than selling a single format for everything.

sections.heading: The research project: 1,800 words, 25%, and where the hours actually go
paragraphs: The business research project carries 25% of the subject grade at Standard Level and at Higher Level, which makes it the largest single component a student controls directly. It runs to a maximum of 1,800 words and it requires a real organisation and a question that the available information can answer. Those two requirements are where the hours go, and where families underestimate the cost most badly.

Finding the organisation comes first, and in Abu Dhabi it is more often solved through a parent's own workplace than through a cold approach. A student who has access to someone willing to answer questions, share figures or describe a decision has a project. A student who has chosen a large multinational from the internet and hopes to find enough public information usually has a problem that only becomes visible in the second draft.

Framing the question comes second and it is the highest-return hour on the whole project. A question has to be narrow enough to answer inside 1,800 words, concrete enough that the available information bears on it, and genuinely open rather than rhetorical. Most mid-band projects were decided here: the question was too broad, the information did not exist, and everything written afterwards was an attempt to disguise that.

The remaining hours go to methodology, tool selection and the word budget. Students consistently spend their words on description and arrive at the evaluation with two hundred left, which is the wrong way round for the criteria. What a tutor does across all of this has a hard boundary: teaching research method, explaining what the criteria reward, and commenting on drafts the student has written. Supplying text, choosing the organisation and question outright, or revising a draft into a submission is malpractice under IB rules, with consequences that fall on the candidate.

sections.heading: Finance and accounts, and why it drives the bill
paragraphs: If an Abu Dhabi family is going to buy one block of Business Management support across two years, this is reliably the one they end up buying, and it is reliably the one that produces the clearest return. The reason is simple: it is the only unit in the subject where a student can be straightforwardly wrong.

Everything else in Business Management rewards judgement, and a weak answer on motivation theory or marketing strategy still scores something. A cash flow forecast with an arithmetic error scores nothing for that item, and a ratio interpreted backwards is worse than no interpretation at all. Students who are strong on the discursive units arrive at final accounts, ratio analysis, break-even and investment appraisal and discover that fluency does not help them.

The content is bounded and mechanical, which is why four to six sessions usually covers it. Ratios have to be taught as interpretation rather than as formulae: knowing that a current ratio is one thing, saying what a current ratio of 0.8 implies for a specific organisation in a specific context is the marked skill. Break-even and cash flow have to be practised under time pressure, because the arithmetic is easy and the errors are all careless. Working has to be written in the form the mark scheme credits, since method marks are available independently of the final figure.

There is a cost timing point here that families miss. Most schools teach finance and accounts in the second term of DP1, and most families buy support for it in DP2 when a mock paper exposes the weakness. Buying the same four to six sessions at the point the unit is taught costs the same and prevents a year of answers written on a shaky base. It also means the quantitative work in the research project is approached by a student who can already read a set of accounts.

sections.heading: Higher Level Paper 3 and the Higher Level premium
paragraphs: Higher Level Business Management adds a third paper, built on an unseen case concerning a social enterprise, and it is the clearest reason a Higher Level plan costs more than a Standard Level one in this emirate. It carries a meaningful share of the Higher Level grade and it asks for something the other two papers do not.

Paper 3 wants a recommendation. Not an analysis, not a balanced discussion, but a specific course of action chosen and justified against the organisation's actual constraints, with the alternatives acknowledged and the risks named. Students who write strong Paper 2 evaluations frequently write unusable Paper 3 answers, because a good evaluation weighs and declines to choose, and this paper requires a choice.

The social enterprise framing matters too, and it is easy to underestimate. A social enterprise has objectives that are not reducible to profit, which changes what counts as a good recommendation. A proposal that improves margin while undermining the organisation's social purpose is not a strong answer, and students trained on commercial cases reach for it instinctively.

The cost consequence is a separate block of four to six sessions, focused on the recommendation structure and on reading an unseen case under time pressure. It is teachable, and some of it works in a shared format because the structure is common. What is individual is the student's own habit of hedging rather than deciding, and that needs marked answers and one-to-one feedback to shift.

sections.heading: How to read a Business Management tutoring quote in this market
paragraphs: Abu Dhabi parents receive quotes that look comparable and are not. Reading one properly takes about five questions, and asking them is the cheapest cost control available. Nothing in this section is unique to Business Management, but the pre-released case study and the shared-session option make the questions sharper here than in most subjects.

Ask what a session actually is. Forty-five minutes and ninety minutes are both called a session in this market. Ask whether the rate is per hour or per lesson, and whether the figure quoted includes any preparation or feedback time. Ask whether the tutor is a Business Management specialist or a generalist across business and economics, and which of the two they taught most recently at Diploma level.

Ask what happens to unused sessions in a package, and ask whether the package tutor is the person you spoke to. Monthly packages circulating in this market run around AED 799 for eight online sessions and AED 1,599 to AED 1,799 for four two-hour in-home sessions. An eight-session package of generalist hours is not cheaper than four specialist hours if the thing you need is investment appraisal.

Ask about value added tax treatment of the quoted figure, and whether the price you have been given is inclusive. A provider should be able to tell you plainly whether their quoted AED figure includes VAT; the general tax position for education services is a matter for the Federal Tax Authority and not something a tutoring page should assert. Finally, ask whether the tutor holds a current MoHRE private tuition work permit, and whether they teach at your child's school.

sections.heading: Business Management support beside everything else an Abu Dhabi family pays
paragraphs: Comparing a tutoring rate with another tutoring rate is the least informative comparison available. The useful frame is the rest of the education budget, because that determines whether a plan survives two years rather than one term.

On fees as context: KHDA confirmed in May 2026 that private school fees in Dubai would not rise for the 2026-27 academic year, under an incentives package Dubai valued at AED 1.5 billion inside a AED 2.5 billion total. Abu Dhabi fees run through ADEK's own approval process. Tutoring has no equivalent cap or freeze, which is the strongest available argument for buying mechanical repairs early rather than emergency hours late.

Bestimate's monthly estimates for a single weekly hour are AED 240 to AED 600 at the budget end, AED 600 to AED 1,200 in the middle and AED 1,000 to AED 2,000 and above for specialist exam-year support. For Business Management the realistic shape is different from a continuous weekly hour: most families spend in three concentrated blocks rather than evenly, which means a lower two-year total if the blocks are bought at the right moments.

One item almost nobody budgets: examination entry for a retake or for a candidate sitting outside their school. Those fees are set by the board and the examination centre, arranged through the school, and entirely separate from tuition. Confirm them with the Diploma coordinator before committing a monthly tutoring figure that leaves no room for them.

sections.heading: ADEK, the permit, and who may lawfully take your money
paragraphs: Abu Dhabi and Al Ain private schools are overseen by the Department of Education and Knowledge, which u.ae describes as supervising the licensing and accreditation of private schools in the emirate. ADEK publishes inspection outcomes and runs the fee-increase process. Not one of the competitor pages measured in this research set names it, on pages written for Abu Dhabi parents.

The rule that affects a family's choice most directly concerns teachers. Gulf News reported that ADEK's professional-ethics rules for private and charter school staff prohibit paid private tutoring of students enrolled at the teacher's own school, and that staff tutoring outside school hours must hold the MoHRE private tuition work permit, whose code of conduct bars serving students affiliated with their own school. Verify the current wording against ADEK's own policy document before relying on it.

Federally, the position is documented. The MoHRE private tutor work permit was introduced by Ministerial Resolution No. 710 of 2023, is granted free of charge for two years, and is open to registered school teachers, government and private-sector employees, unemployed residents, university students and school students aged 15 to 18. Individuals offering private tutoring without a permit are subject to fines and penalties under the applicable laws. No fine schedule has been published, so any specific amount quoted at you is unverified. MoHRE's own Private Tutor Licensing service lists no fee and a two-working-day completion time.

A separate point worth stating because of what this subject is about. A tutoring business with premises and staff in Dubai needs a KHDA Educational Services Permit as a training institute, which is a specific licence issued to a specific kind of operation. IB Gram is an online tutor-matching platform; it holds no such permit, no regulator accreditation, and no premises in the UAE, and a page that implied otherwise would be making exactly the kind of claim this section exists to warn you about.
